--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 미래 기사(future_knight) 양손검 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualFutureKnight2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- hitabble distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == 'stomp' then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = radius

	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 지속 시간
		local hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')
		--- 충돌체 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 충돌체 각
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, hit_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = radius

	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 판정 크기
		local size = vector(length, height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = length
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.attack_type ~= 'thrust'
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- target dist
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_obj = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	closest_obj = closest_obj or target

	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
	local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_obj)

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

	return distance <= min_dist + self.hittable_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set upper animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- shake character
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.1, self.action.action_duration)

		local current_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

		local arm_slot = current_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and '[base]armR' or '[base]armL'
		local weapon_slot = '[base]weapon1'

		--- 본 가져옴
		self.arm_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, arm_slot).Bone
		self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, weapon_slot).Bone

		--- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
		local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.arm_bone.WorldRotationX, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

		--- 찌르기 이펙트 생성
		self.thrust_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'thrust', init_pos - 0.5 * bone_rot, bone_rot)

		--- 찌르기 사운드 재생
		self.thrust_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust')

		--- 랜덤 밸류
		local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 6

		if value < 1 then
			--- 재생할 보이스 선택
			local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
				CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
				value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

			---보이스 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
		end
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 찌르기가 아닐때
	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 찌르기 사운드 fade
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.thrust_holder, 0.5)
		self.thrust_holder = nil

		if self.current_time_passed < self.action.action_duration then
			--- 찌르기 이펙트 해지
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.thrust_fx, true)
		end

		self.thrust_fx = nil

		self.weapon_bone = nil
		self.arm_bone = nil

		--- cancel shake
		character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.dash_duration > 0 then
		--- 대시 시간 이전까지 갱신
		if old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
			--- 대상 방향 갱신
			self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- 대시 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
				0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil, false, 0
			)

			if self.attack_type == 'stomp' then
				--- 점프 연출
				character_util.jump(self.owner, 1.2, self.dash_duration)

				--- 점프 사운드 재생
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')
			end
		end
	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- look dir
		local last_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

		--- 대상 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		local current_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

		--- 방향이 다른 경우
		if current_dir ~= last_dir then
			local arm_slot = current_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and '[base]armR' or '[base]armL'
			local weapon_slot = '[base]weapon1'

			--- 본 가져옴
			self.arm_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, arm_slot).Bone
			self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, weapon_slot).Bone
		end

		--- set ik
		spine_util.set_aim_point(
			self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		)

		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)

		--- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
		local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.arm_bone.WorldRotationX, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

		effect_util.update_object(self.thrust_fx, init_pos - 0.5 * bone_rot, bone_rot)
	end

	--- 일반 공격 1타
	if self.attack_type == 'stomp' then
		self:stomp_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 일반 공격 2, 3타
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		self:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 일반 공격 4타
	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:stomp_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- stomp offset
		local offset = 0.5

		--- instantiate dash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'stomp', character_util.get_position(self.owner) + offset * self.dir_vector
		)

		--- play stomp sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + offset * self.dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- current modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 물체 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- loop ifo list
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- apply damage
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

function action_state_class:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 히트 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- set calculator position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- owner bounds center
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- slash offset
		local slash_offset = 0.275
		--- init direction
		local direction = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
		--- init position
		local position = center + slash_offset * direction

		--- effect key
		local key = (vector_util.to_direction(direction) & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None and
			'rslash' or 'slash'

		--- instantiate slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, key, position, direction)

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)

		--- set calculator direction
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기가 시작되었을때
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- current modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 물체 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- loop ifo list
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- apply damage
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function action_state_class:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		--- 히트 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- set calculator position
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- set calculator direction
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- current modifier
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.hit_timing
			)

			--- 물체 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

			--- loop ifo list
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- apply damage
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName,
			bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	else
		--- 대상 방향
		damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

		--- 넉백 강도
		local force = self.attack_type == 'slash' and
			knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force or
			knock_back_constants.standard_force
		--- 넉백 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info, force)
	end

	--- hit 사운드가 있을때
	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(

	)

	if target then

	--- append direction

	if self.activate_special_option and random_util.get_random_value() <= self.probability then

	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.sync_dir_vector, arm_pos)
	effect_util.update_object(self.shoot_fx, center + self.shoot_offset * self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 현재 타겟이 없고 타겟이 존재했었다면 (네트워크 타겟 갱신)
	--- [재탐색] 부쉬 대응
	if self.exist_target and (not self.sync_target or bush_util.is_hide(self.sync_target)) then
		--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
			self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
		)

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		if self.sync_target then
			trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.sync_target)
		else
			self.exist_target = false
		end

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)

		--- 커맨드 생성
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	local start_index = math.floor(old_time_passed / self.action_duration) + 1
	local end_index = math.floor(time_passed / self.action_duration)

	--- 타격 인덱스 루프
	for index = start_index, end_index do
		--- 현재 공격 가능한 시점인지?
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, index * self.action_duration) then
			--- 공격이 가능한 스태미나양을 가지고 있다면
			if battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
				--- 공격이 가능한 상태 (네트워크 캐릭터가 아닐 경우)
				if battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
					--- 발사 싱크
					self:sync_proj()
				end
			else --- 그렇지 않다면 스테이트 리셋
				--- 트리거 정보 구성
				local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, self.state.reload.id)
				--- 커맨드 생성
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일 발사 싱크를 위한 커맨드 생성
function local_class:sync_proj()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 프로젝타일 발사는 10 이상의 숫자를 보내 판단 할 수 있도록
	local label = 10

	--- 특수 옵션 발동 정보 추가
	if self.activate_special_option and random_util.get_random_value() <= self.probability then
		label = label + 2
	else
		label = label + 1
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, label)

	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.sync_dir_vector

	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- 실제 프로젝타일 발사
function local_class:shoot_proj(label, dir_vector, shoot_pos)
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[label], shoot_pos, dir_vector, label
	)

	local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
	local bounce_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * dir_vector

	CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center, bounce_dir_vector, self.preset_info['cartridge'])

	character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.action_duration)
end

--endregion

--region reload state

function local_class:enter_reload_state(_)
	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'reload')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'reload')
end

function local_class:exit_reload_state(_)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_reload_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.reload_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, move_info.direction, label, hit_info.position)
	end

	return true
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, dir_vector, label, hit_pos)
	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier = continuous_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	--- 관통탄 넉백 추가
	if label == self.atk_type.penetrate then
		damage_info.modifier = modifier * self.modifier_scale.penetrate
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(
			damage_info, knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * 0.7, knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		)

		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info)
	end

	if self.hit_target[target] == nil then
		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.proj_spec[label].HitPreset, hit_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)

		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

		self.hit_target[target] = unity_class.time.time
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.action_duration * 0.5)
end

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(_, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 추가 projectile 데이터 파싱
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(
			self.cs_shooter, option_param, self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec
		)

		--- 관통탄 발동 확률
		self.probability = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'Probability')

		self.atk_type.penetrate = #self.shoot_helper
		self.modifier_scale.penetrate = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier') + 1

		--- 버프 파싱
		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, false)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('ManualFuturePrincessBattleAction')

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 미래 공주(future_princess) 일반 기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 현재 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = string.lower(cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackType'))
	--- 실제 공격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')

	if self.attack_type == 'stomp' then
		--- 스톰프 범위
		self.distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')

		local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 찌르기 길이
		self.distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Length')
		--- 찌르기 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width')

		self.thrust_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width),
			0.1, nil, true
		)
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.thrust_info)

		--- 당겨올 타이밍
		self.pull_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'PullTiming')

		self.pull_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'PullLength')
		--- 당기기 폭
		width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'PullWidth')

		self.pull_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.pull_length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width),
			self.pull_timing + 0.1, nil, true
		)
		self.pull_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.pull_info , true, self.pull_timing)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 베기 범위
		self.distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
		--- 베기 각
		self.angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Angle')

		local info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.distance, self.angle, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info, true, self.hit_timing)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'magic' then
		self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Speed')
		self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'LifeTime')
		self.explosion_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

		--- 이펙트 보관용 해시셋
		self.fx_holder_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()
	end

	self:apply_option(cs_action, params)

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.sync_target = nil
	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil

	--region state members region
	do
		--- 내부 스테이트 정의
		self.state = {
			--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
			none = {
				enter = function(prev_state) end,
				exit = function(next_state) end,
				update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
			},
			--- 내려찍기 상태
			stomp = {
				enter = self.enter_stomp_state,
				exit = self.exit_stomp_state,
				update = self.update_stomp_state
			},
			--- 찌르기 상태
			thrust = {
				enter = self.enter_thrust_state,
				exit = self.exit_thrust_state,
				update = self.update_thrust_state
			},
			--- 베기 상태
			slash = {
				enter = self.enter_slash_state,
				exit = self.exit_slash_state,
				update = self.update_slash_state
			},
			--- 마법공격 상태
			magic = {
				enter = self.enter_magic_state,
				exit = self.exit_magic_state,
				update = self.update_magic_state
			}
		}

		---- 현재 스테이트
		self.current_state = self.state.none

		--- 현재 스테이트에서 지나간 시간
		self.current_time_passed = 0
		self.finished_time_passed = 0
	end
	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region 스테이트 별 개별 해지
	do
		if self.attack_type == 'magic' then
			if self.fx_holder_set then
				for fx, _ in pairs(self.fx_holder_set) do
					effect_util.dispose_via_type(fx)
				end

				self.fx_holder_set:dispose()
			end

			self.fx_holder_set = nil
		elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
			self.pull_calculator = nil
			self.thrust_info = nil
			self.pull_info = nil
		end

		self.calculator = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

		self.state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		if self.shoot_helper then
			for index = 1, #self.shoot_helper do
				self.shoot_helper[index] = nil
				self.proj_spec[index] = nil
			end

			self.shoot_helper = nil
			self.proj_spec = nil
			self.cs_shooter = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.animation_info do
			self.animation_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.emotion_info do
			self.emotion_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.preset_info do
			self.preset_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.sfx_info do
			self.sfx_info[index] = nil
		end

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

----- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.current_time_passed = 0
	self.finished_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and
		(self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper))
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state and self.current_state == self.state.none
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 마법공격이 아니라면 컨트롤을 제어함
	return self.attack_type ~= 'magic'
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if self.attack_type ~= 'magic' then
		--- 대상 방향
		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

		--- extension cache
		local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
		local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

		--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
		end

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			self.owner.Bounds,
			entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
			dash_dist * direction
		)

		--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
		if closest_object == nil then
			closest_object = target
		end

		--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
		local min_dist = math.min(
			bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
		)

		return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + self.distance * 0.8

	else
		--- 투사체 높이
		local height = 2
		--- 투사체 사거리
		local proj_dist = self.speed * self.life_time

		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_position = self.owner.Position + height * unity_class.vector3.up

		return vector_util.distance(shoot_position, bounds_util.get_center(target)) <= proj_dist * 0.8
	end
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 옵션이 발동된 상태
	if self.cwp_activate_option and character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_id) then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.on_boost = trigger_info_util.contains_number(info)

	self:change_state(self.state[self.attack_type])
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.attack_type == 'magic' then
		self:sync_magic_state(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	--- 실제 delta time
	--- 공속 증가 패시브가 있어서 이 부분에서 보정해줌
	local real_dt = dt

	--- 공속 옵션이 발동되어 있을때
	if self.on_boost then
		real_dt = real_dt * self.attack_speed_scale
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + real_dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, real_dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.finished_time_passed = self.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.action_duration <= self.current_time_passed then
		self:state_end_routine()
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine()
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region stomp state

--- Stomp 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_stomp_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	self:request_set_anim('action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action')

	--- request short dash
	self:request_melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		0, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0
	)
end

--- Stomp 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_stomp_state(_)
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Stomp 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_stomp_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		local stomp_position = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector

		--- instantiate stomp fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'stomp', stomp_position)
		--- play stomp sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'stomp')

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, stomp_position)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		self:update_calculator(self.calculator, dt, stomp_position, stomp_position, self.attack_modifier, 12000)

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

--region thrust state

--- Thrust 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_thrust_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	self:request_set_anim('action')

	self:request_melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		self.hit_timing, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0.5
	)

	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- set IK
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.sync_dir_vector, center)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 초기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.pull_calculator, center)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.pull_calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	area_collision_util.start(self.pull_calculator)
end

--- Thrust 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_thrust_state(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.pull_calculator)

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Thrust 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_thrust_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- instantiate thrust fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'thrust',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.sync_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

		--- play thrust sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'thrust')
	end

	--- 찌르기 판정
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local thrust_progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.1, 1)

		self.thrust_info.Size = vector_util.get_0yz(self.thrust_info.Size, self.distance * thrust_progress)

		self:update_calculator(
			self.calculator, dt, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.attack_modifier * 0.5, 12000, self.sync_dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.pull_timing) then
		--- set pull anim
		self:request_set_anim('pull')

		--- instantiate pull fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'pull', self.owner.Position, -self.sync_dir_vector)

		--- play pull sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'pull')
	end

	--- 당기기 판정
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.pull_calculator) then
		local pull_position = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		local pull_progress = 1 - math.min(math.max(old_time_passed - self.pull_timing, 0) / 0.1, 1)

		self.pull_info.Size = vector_util.get_0yz(self.pull_info.Size, self.pull_length * pull_progress)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.pull_calculator, pull_position)

		--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.pull_calculator, dt)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then

				local mass = target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass
				local target_center = bounds_util.get_center(target)

				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pull_position - target_center)

				local target_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
				local target_dir_vertor = vector_util.normalized(diff)

				local force = battle_util.get_pull_knock_back_force(target_dist * 1.5, mass)

				self:apply_damage(
					target, pull_position, self.attack_modifier * 0.5, force, target_dir_vertor
				)
			end
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 공격 완료
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.pull_calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.pull_calculator)
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--- Slash 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_slash_state(_)
	--- 4-way atk
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction)

	--- set slash anim
	self:request_set_anim('slash')

	--- play slash sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')

	self:request_melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		self.hit_timing, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0.5
	)

	--- to 4-way vector3
	self.sync_dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 초기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

--- Slash 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_slash_state(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

--- Slash 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_slash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing - 0.02) then
		--- instantiate slash fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'slash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.2 * self.sync_dir_vector,
			self.sync_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)
		end
	end

	--- 공격이 진행 중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		self:update_calculator(
			self.calculator, dt,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.attack_modifier, 16000
		)
	end
end

--region magic state

--- Magic 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_magic_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set charge anim
	self:request_set_anim('charge')

	--- instantiate charge fx
	self.pooled_charge = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'charge',
		self.owner.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.up, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play charge sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'charge')
end

--- Magic 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_magic_state(_)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.pooled_charge)
	self.pooled_charge = nil

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Magic 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_magic_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing - 0.1) then
		--- set fire anim
		self:request_set_anim('fire')
	end

	if old_time_passed <= self.hit_timing then
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		if self.hit_timing < time_passed then

			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.pooled_charge)
			self.pooled_charge = nil

			--- 투사체 높이
			local height = 2
			--- 투사체 사거리
			local proj_dist = self.speed * self.life_time

			--- 발사 위치
			local shoot_position = self.owner.Position + height * unity_class.vector3.up

			--- 타겟이 존재하고 사거리내인가
			local is_valid_target = self.sync_target and
				vector_util.distance(shoot_position, bounds_util.get_center(self.sync_target)) <= proj_dist

			--- 목표 위치
			local target_position = is_valid_target and
				self.sync_target.Position or
				self.owner.Position + math.sqrt(proj_dist ^ 2 - height ^ 2) * self.sync_dir_vector

			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_position)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target_position)

			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync_magic_state(info)
	local shoot_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local target_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
		self.owner, util.cs_generator(self.on_shoot_routine, self, shoot_position, target_position)
	)
end

function local_class:on_shoot_routine(shoot_position, target_position)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(target_position - shoot_position)
	local distance = vector_util.distance(target_position, shoot_position)
	local target_time_passed = distance / self.speed

	local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(direction)).eulerAngles.y
	local rotZ = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, vector(math.sqrt(1 - direction.y ^ 2), direction.y, 0)).eulerAngles.z

	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, rotZ)

	--- instantiate shoot fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', shoot_position)
	--- play shoot sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	local proj_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', shoot_position, rot)
	local trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', shoot_position, rot)

	-- 외부에서 지울 수 있도록 해시셋에 등록해둠
	-- 이게 유효하지 않다는 의미는 이미 파괴되었다는 의미
	self.fx_holder_set:add(proj_fx)
	self.fx_holder_set:add(trail_fx)

	--- local time passed
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 이펙트 셋이 유효하지 않다면 무언가 잘못된 것
	while self.fx_holder_set and time_passed < target_time_passed do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = math.min(time_passed / target_time_passed, 1)

		local current_position = vector_util.lerp(shoot_position, target_position, progress)

		proj_fx.transform.position = current_position
		trail_fx.transform.position = current_position

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 이펙트 셋이 유효하지 않다면 무언가 잘못된 상황이기 때문에 바로 이탈한다.
	-- 이펙트 오브젝트도 셋이 해제될 때 같이 해제되었을 것이라 해제도 생략한다.
	if not self.fx_holder_set then
		return
	end

	-- 이펙트 셋에서 등록된 이펙트를 해제한다.
	self.fx_holder_set:remove(proj_fx)
	self.fx_holder_set:remove(trail_fx)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(proj_fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(trail_fx)

	proj_fx = nil
	trail_fx = nil

	self:on_explosion(target_position)
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position)
	--- instantiate explosion fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', explosion_position)
	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(explosion_position, self.explosion_radius)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target, explosion_position, self.attack_modifier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--endregion

--- 충돌체 계산기 업데이트
--- @param calculator any 사용할 충돌체 계산기
--- @param calc_position any 갱신할 충돌체 계산기의 위치
--- @param hit_position any 데미지를 준 위치
--- @param modifier number 데미지 계수
--- @param knock_back_force number 넉백 계수
--- @param knock_back_dir_vector any 넉백 방향
function local_class:update_calculator(
	calculator, dt, calc_position, hit_position, modifier,
	knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector
)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, calc_position)

	--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target, hit_position, modifier, knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 공격 완료 (충돌체 계산기 종료)
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(
	target, position, modifier, knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector
)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, modifier)
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	if knock_back_force then
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(knock_back_dir_vector, dir_vector)
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_force
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	if option_id > 0 and self.owner:HasValidOption(option_id) then
		local option_data = game_data_service.GetData('OptionData')
		local option_param = option_data:GetSpec(option_id).Data

		--- 옵션이 발동 했는가
		self.cwp_activate_option = true

		--- 기본 공속 1을 포함한 공속 증가량
		self.attack_speed_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AttackSpeedScale') + 1

		--- 옵션이 실제 발동 중인지 체킹할 기준이 될 버프
		local buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BuffName')

		local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(buff_name).Data

		self.buff_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'BuffId')[1]

	end
end

function local_class:request_set_anim(key)
	if self.animation_info[key] == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.on_boost then
		local request = self.animation_info[key]

		local scaling_request = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
			request.name, request.priority, request.loop, request.timescale * self.attack_speed_scale,
			request.removeAfter, request.mixDuration, nil, request.nextAnimation
		)

		self.owner:SetUpperAnimation(self.cs_action, scaling_request)
	else
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, key)
	end
end

function local_class:request_melee_short_dash(
	cs_action, target, dir_vector,
	stay_duration, dash_duration, speed, non_manual_speed,
	on_block, cancel_by_atomic_move, manual_min_distance
)
	if self.on_boost then
		stay_duration = stay_duration / self.attack_speed_scale
		dash_duration = dash_duration / self.attack_speed_scale
		speed = speed * self.attack_speed_scale
		non_manual_speed = non_manual_speed * self.attack_speed_scale
	end

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(cs_action, target, dir_vector,
		stay_duration, dash_duration, speed, non_manual_speed,
		on_block, cancel_by_atomic_move, manual_min_distance)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

local local_class = newclass('ManualGaram2BattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 일반 공격 계산용 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')
	--- 힐 계수
	self.heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealModifier')

	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

	--- 부채꼴 판정
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

	--- 충돌체
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, self.action_duration)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)


	self.hittable_dist = (radius + self.offset) * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self:apply_option(param)

	--local action = self.action.animation_info['cast']
	--local original_action_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.owner.SpineController, action.name)
	--action.timescale = original_action_duration / 0.7
	--self.action.animation_info['cast'] = action
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			self.crit_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'CritDebuff')
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- set upper anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 공격 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	--- remove upper anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상 방향 갱신
	if old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		local attack_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 공격 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', attack_pos, self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		local attack_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, attack_pos, self.dir_vector)

		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 일반 공격의 데미지 모디파이어 계산
			local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
				self.cs_action,
				self.action_duration,
				self.break_modifier - 1
			)

			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(modifier, target)

				if self.activate_cwp_option then
					buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.crit_debuff_info)
				end
			end
			self:apply_ally_heal()
		end
	end

	--- 액션 시간 만료에 따른 정리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(modifier, target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:apply_ally_heal()
	--- 전투 중이 아니라면 적용하지 않는다.
	if not battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then return end
	--- 아군 목록
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)
	--- 아군이 없다면 생략함
	if #stage_members == 0 then return end

	--- 회복력 비례 힐량
	local amount = math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_multiplier)

	--- 아군 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 힐이 적용 불가능한 경우 생략함
		if not battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, member, false) then break end

		self:apply_heal(member, amount)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			self:apply_heal(summonable, amount)
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_heal(target)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_multiplier)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end
--endregion

		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인

	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	self.any_hit = false
end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 방향 갱신
	if old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing - 0.2) then
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.2, 0.25)
	end

	--- fx 파도

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, nil, nil, true)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'break')

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then

function break_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 지속 시간 만료
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'break_end', hit_info.position, self.dir_vector)
		return true
	end

	--- 대상 캐시
	local hit_target = hit_info.target

	--- 대상을 공격 여부 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_target) == false then return false end
	--- 일반 공격의 데미지 모디파이어 계산
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action,
		self.action_duration,
		self.break_modifier - 1
	)
	--- 스테미나 브레이크 데미지 배율
	modifier = modifier * self.break_modifier

	self:apply_damage(modifier, hit_target)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'break_hit', bounds_util.get_center(hit_target), self.dir_vector)

	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, hit_target, self.crit_debuff_info)
	end

		return
	end

	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 스태미너 브레이크 인가?
	local break_attack = discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action)
	--- 현재 라벨
	local label = break_attack and self.atk_type.stamina_break or self.atk_type.default

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, false
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)

	--- 발사 목표 포지션
	local target_pos = target and
		target.Position or
		self.owner.Position + dir_vector

	--- 탄 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, label)

	--- 가능한 각도 계산
	local avail_angle = self:get_avail_angle(target_pos, self.proj_spec[label])

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, avail_angle, 0) * dir_vector)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -avail_angle, 0) * dir_vector)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 타겟 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 대상 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	--- 발사 방향 Sync
	self.shoot_dir_vector[1] = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 1)
	self.shoot_dir_vector[2] = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 2)

	--- 공격 Type Sync
	self.sync_label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state.action)

end

--region action state

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector))

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 스펙 기반 발사 사운드 재생
	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[self.sync_label])

	for index = 1, #self.shoot_dir_vector do
		if self.sync_target then
			--- shoot
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[self.sync_label], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.shoot_dir_vector[index],
				self.sync_label, nil, self.sync_target
			)
		else
			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.shoot_dir_vector[index]

			--- shoot
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[self.sync_label], shoot_pos, self.sync_dir_vector,
				self.sync_label, nil, nil
			)
		end
	end

	--- 스태미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 브레이크 공격
	if self.sync_label == self.atk_type.stamina_break then
		--- set action emo
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.sync_dir_vector, 0.1, 0.1, self.action_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(next_state)
	---- remove emo
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 다음 액션이 none 일때 (액션이 종료되었을때)
	if next_state and next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		--- cancel recoil
		character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

		--- remove locked direction
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		--- clear target
		self.sync_target = nil
	end
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.attacking and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self:on_action_available()
		--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region explosion

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료이면 그냥 만료 시키도록
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		return true
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position, label)

		--- 프로젝타일 만료
		return true
	end

	--- 프로젝타일 지속
	return false
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position, label)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, explosion_position)

	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration,
		self.modifier_scale.stamina_break - self.modifier_scale.default
	)

	if label == self.atk_type.default then
		modifier = modifier * 0.5 * self.modifier_scale.default
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.12)

	else
		modifier = modifier * 0.5 * self.modifier_scale.stamina_break
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- 브레이크 공격일 경우 힐
		self:on_party_heal()
	end

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
		explosion_position, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec)
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, explosion_position, modifier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_party_heal()
	--- 배틀 매니저 없거나 전투 중이 아니라면 힐하지 않으면 리턴
	if battle_manager == nil or battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner) == nil then
		return
	end

	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)

	--- 파티가 존재할때
	if party then
		--- 회복량 기반 힐량 계산
		local amount = character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_multiplier

		--- 특수 능력이 발동된 상태라면
		if self.activate_special_option then
			amount = amount * self.special_heal_multiplier
		end

		local members = party:GetStageMembers()
		--- 힐 가능한 파티멤버들에게 힐
		for _, member in pairs(members) do
			if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, member, false) then
				self:apply_heal(member, amount)
			end

			--- 소환수가 있다면 힐
			local summonables = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)

			for index = 1, #summonables do
				self:apply_heal(summonables[index], amount)
			end
		end

		members:Dispose()
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, modifier)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(
		vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position)
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	if self.sfx_info['hit'] then
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
	--- play heal sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'heal')

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(heal_amount)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--endregion

--region get angle

function local_class:get_avail_angle(target_pos, spec)
	--- 최대 발사 각
	local spin = 60

	--- 실제 shoot offset
	local shoot_offset = 0.5
	--- 최대각을 고려한 offset
	local offset = math.cos(math.rad(spin)) * shoot_offset
	--- 대상의 뒤쪽으로 유도 되도록 보정할 offset
	local back_offset = 0.5

	--- 발사 각도를 꺾더라도 homing 에 의해 대상에게 명중할 수 있어야 하므로 최대 꺾을 수 있는 각도를 계산
	local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos), vector_util.get_x0z(self.owner.Position))
	--- 오프셋 보정
	dist = math.max(dist - offset + back_offset, 0)

	local speed = battle_util.get_number(spec.Speed)
	local accel = battle_util.get_number(spec.Accel)

	--- 대상 위치에 도달하는 시간 계산
	local duration = (math.sqrt(speed ^ 2 + 2 * accel * dist) - speed) / accel

	--- 정면으로 날아간다 가정할 때 걸리는 시간 계산
	local est_time = math.min(duration, battle_util.get_number(spec.Lifetime))

	--- 해당 시간 동안 꺾을 수 있는 각도 / 2
	local avail_angle = est_time * battle_util.get_number(spec.HomingAngularSpeed) / 2

	--- 최대각도와 가능각도 중 작은것으로 발사
	return math.min(avail_angle, spin)
end

--endregion

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(_, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	if option_id > 0 and self.owner:HasValidOption(option_id) then
		local option_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('OptionData')
		local option_param = option_data:GetSpec(option_id).Data

		--- 회복량 계수
		self.special_heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealMultiplier')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
