local local_class = newclass('ManualGaramBowBattleAction')

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 구미호 신선 가람(garam) 일반 기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대상을 탐색할 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 힐량 계수
	self.heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HealMultiplier')

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	--- 폭발 각
	self.angle = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'Angle')
	--- 폭발 데미지 계수
	self.explosion_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExplosionDamageScale')

	--- 폭발 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(
		0, 0, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)
	--- 폭발 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 전용무기 옵션이 발동 했는가
	self.activate_cwp_option = self:apply_option(cs_action, params)

	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil
	--- 싱크된 공격 타입
	self.sync_label = nil

	--- 공격 타입
	self.atk_type = {
		--- 일반
		default = 1,
		--- 브레이크
		stamina_break = 2
	}

	--- 공격 계수
	self.modifier_scale = {
		--- 일반
		default = 1,
		--- 브레이크
		stamina_break = 2
	}

	--region state members region

	--- 내부 스테이트 정의
	self.state = {
		--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
		none = {
			id = 1,
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
		},
		--- 공격 상태
		action = {
			id = 2,
			enter = self.enter_action_state,
			exit = self.exit_action_state,
			update = self.update_action_state
		}
	}

	---- 현재 스테이트
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	--- 현재 스테이트에서 지나간 시간
	self.current_time_passed = 0

	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

		self.state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info, self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec
		)

		self.calculator = nil
		self.collision_info = nil

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

----- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.current_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때, 캐릭터가 다른 동작을 하고 있지 않을때 사용 가능
	return self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 사용중 이동이 가능함
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- default 탄을 기준으로 무조건 계산
	local dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[self.atk_type.default]) * 0.8
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= dist
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션 캔슬
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- state update
	self:on_state_update(dt)

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
function local_class:on_state_update(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 스태미너 브레이크 인가?
	local break_attack = discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action)
	--- 현재 라벨
	local label = break_attack and self.atk_type.stamina_break or self.atk_type.default

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local _, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)

	--- 탄 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, label)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local shoot_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		local label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(shoot_pos, shoot_dir_vector, label, target)
	else
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		--- 대상 방향 Sync
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--- 공격 Type Sync
		self.sync_label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

		--- state change
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--region action state

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector))

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action')

	--- 투사체 스펙 기반 발사 사운드 재생
	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[self.sync_label])

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[self.sync_label], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_label
	)

	--- 스태미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 브레이크 공격
	if self.sync_label == self.atk_type.stamina_break then
		--- set action emo
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.sync_dir_vector, 0.4, 0.13, self.action_duration * 0.3)
	else
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.sync_dir_vector, 0.2, 0.13, self.action_duration * 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(next_state)
	--- remove emo
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 다음 액션이 none 일때 (액션이 종료되었을때)
	if next_state and next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		--- cancel recoil
		character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

		--- remove locked direction
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.attacking and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self:on_action_available()
			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region explosion

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 있는 경우에만 (추가타 싱크를 위함)
	if hit_info.target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, hit_info.target)
	end

	--- 폭발 위치 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)
	--- 폭발 방향 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, move_info.direction)

	--- 폭발한 타입 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, label)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

	--- 프로젝타일 만료
	return true
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position, dir_vector, label, hit_target)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- 판정 반지름 갱신
	self.collision_info.Radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec)
	self.collision_info.Angle = self.angle[label]

	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration,
		self.modifier_scale.stamina_break - self.modifier_scale.default
	)

	--- 공격 타입에 따른 계수
	if label == self.atk_type.default then
		modifier = modifier * self.modifier_scale.default

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	else
		--- 브레이크 공격일 경우 힐
		self:on_party_heal()

		--- 브레이크일 경우
		modifier = modifier * self.modifier_scale.stamina_break

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.1)
	end

	--- 전용무기 옵션이 발동하지 않았다면
	if self.activate_cwp_option == false then
		--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, explosion_position, dir_vector)
	--- 전용무기 옵션이 발동되었다면 계수를 그대로 감
	else
		local key = string.format('explosion%d', label)
		--- 강화 폭발 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, key, explosion_position, dir_vector)
		--- 강화 폭발 sfx 생성
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, key)
	end

	--- 충돌체 세팅 및 시작
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, explosion_position)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, dir_vector)
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

	--- 확산 폭발에 영향을 받는 타겟의 개수
	local another_target_count = 0
	local another_target

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 폭발 범위에 있는 대상이 발사체를 직접 맞는 타겟이 아니고 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, target) and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 폭발로 영향 받는 타겟의 수를 증가
			another_target_count = another_target_count + 1

			--- 영향 받는 타겟이 1명 이상이거나 직접 영향 주는 타겟이 존재한다면
			if another_target_count > 1 or hit_target or not self.activate_cwp_option then
				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self:apply_damage(target, explosion_position, modifier * self.explosion_scale, label)
			else
				--- 직접 영향 주는 타겟이 없고 확산에 영향받는 타겟이 1명일 경우에 대한 처리를 하기 위함
				another_target = target
			end
		end
	end

	--- 영향 받는 타겟 후보군이 존재할때
	if another_target then
		local another_target_modifier =  modifier * self.explosion_scale

		--- 확산 폭발의 영향을 받는 대상이 1명일때
		if  another_target_count == 1 then
			another_target_modifier = another_target_modifier +
				battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.single_dps_multiplier)

			--- 추가타 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(another_target))
		end

		--- 캐싱해둔 타겟에게 데미지 커맨드 발행
		self:apply_damage(another_target, explosion_position, another_target_modifier, label)
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 충돌체 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 프로젝타일을 직접 맞은 타겟이 존재한다면
	if hit_target then
		--- 폭발로 영향 받은 타겟이 없었을때
		if another_target_count == 0 and self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 단일 대상 계수를 더해줌
			modifier = modifier +
				battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.single_dps_multiplier)

			--- 추가타 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(hit_target))
		end

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		self:apply_damage(hit_target, explosion_position, modifier, label)
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_heal()
	--- 배틀 매니저 없거나 전투 중이 아니라면 힐하지 않으면 리턴
	if battle_manager == nil or battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner) == nil then
		return
	end

	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)

	--- 파티가 존재할때
	if party then
		--- 회복량 기반 힐량 계산
		local amount = character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_multiplier
		local members = party:GetStageMembers()

		--- 힐 가능한 파티멤버들에게 힐
		for _, member in pairs(members) do
			if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, member, false) then
				self:apply_heal(member, amount)
			end

			--- 소환수가 있다면 힐
			local summonables = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)

			for index = 1, #summonables do
				self:apply_heal(summonables[index], amount)
			end
		end

		members:Dispose()
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, modifier, label)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(
		vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position)
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	--- 슈퍼코스튬에서는 피격음을 제거해야되서 추가했다.
	--- 피격음이 있다면 전용 피격음을 적용한다.
	if self.sfx_info['hit'] then
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(
		damage_info,
		knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * 0.5,
		projectile_spec_util.get_knock_back_factor(self.proj_spec[label])
	)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
	--- play heal sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'heal')

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(heal_amount)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--endregion

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	if option_id > 0 and self.owner:HasValidOption(option_id) then
		local option_data = game_data_service.GetData('OptionData')
		local option_param = option_data:GetSpec(option_id).Data

		--- 추가 정보 파싱
		_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, option_param, nil, nil, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		--- 단일 대상 추가 데미지 배율
		self.single_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SingleTargetDpsMultiplier')

		--- 새로운 폭발 계수
		self.explosion_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ExplosionDamageScale')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 뿔 사냥꾼 토가 (goat_girl) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualGoatGirlBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = 0,
	--- 액션 유지 시간
	action_duration = 0,
	--- 데미지 유형
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = 0,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = 0,
	--- 슈터 정보
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- 슈팅 헬퍼
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- 투사체 유형
	atk_type = nil,
	--- 발사 위치 오프셋
	offset = 0,
	--- 적중 가능한 거리
	hittable_dist = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create break state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 공격 가능한 거리
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 위치에 대한 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	self.normal_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'NormalRadius')

	self.atk_type = self.action.atk_type

	--- 기본 투사체 폭발
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		self.normal_radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, nil, nil, nil, false
	)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 문양 공깍 디버프
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param,'SymbolDebuff')

	self:apply_option(param)
	--- 미리 캐싱처리.
	self.shoot_sfx_keys = {'shoot1', 'shoot2', 'shoot3'}
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then break end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특능 발동 여부
				self.activate_special_option = true
			else
				--- 전용무기 옵션 발동 여부
				self.activate_cwp_option = true
				--- parsing each info
				battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

				--- 전무 인해 공깍 문양을 덮어쓴다 (지속시간 긴버전)
				self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'SymbolDebuff')
				--- 전무 속성 저항 추가
				self.resist_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
			end

		until true
	end
end

function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	self.current_proj_type =  trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
end

function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)
	--- 공격 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local is_break_atk = self.current_proj_type == self.atk_type.break_atk

	local anim_key = is_break_atk and 'break' or 'shoot'
	--- set upper anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- remove upper anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 유효하면 방향 갱신
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 에임 방향 갱신
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- 발사 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 1번은 일반탄, 2번은 브레이크탄 - current_proj_type
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[self.current_proj_type], shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[self.current_proj_type], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, self.current_proj_type
		)

		--- 발포음
		if self.current_proj_type == self.atk_type.break_atk then
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot_break')
		else
			local seed = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.shoot_sfx_keys)
			--- 1,2,3 무작위 사격음
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, self.shoot_sfx_keys[seed])
		end

		local mag = self.current_proj_type == 1 and 0.06 or 0.17
		local duration = self.current_proj_type == 1 and 0.2 or 0.23

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, mag, duration)

		--- 발사 반동
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.18, 0.05, 0.15)

		--- 탄피 연출. 무작위방향으로 튀는 탄피
		local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
		local bounce_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector
		CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center, bounce_dir)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 벽, 투사체 적중시에만 폭발
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate or
		hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then return true end

	--- 적중시 무조건 폭발
	self:send_explosion_sync(hit_info.position, label)

	return true
end

--- 폭발 위치 동기화 목적으로 커맨드를 보낸다.
function action_state_class:send_explosion_sync(pos, label)
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)

	--- 브레이크 탄이라면
	if label == self.atk_type.break_atk then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, 1)
	end

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- 노말 투사체 폭발
function action_state_class:on_explosion(info)
	--- hit_info.position
	local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.12)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, pos)
	--- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
	for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do

		self:apply_damage(target)

		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info)

		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.resist_debuff_info)
		end
	end

	--- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', pos)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 배율 계산
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action,
		self.action_duration,
		self.break_modifier - 1
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	--- 데미지 커맨드 생성
	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 크리티컬인 경우 (local user only)
	if result_info and result_info.critical then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit_crit')
	end
end
--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 배율
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 위치
	target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 0.3초 후 폭발할 시간
	self.delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Break2Timing')

	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainScale')
	self.sub_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')

	self.first_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Break1Radius')
	self.second_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Break2Radius')

	--- 폭발 판정 지름
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		self.first_radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, nil, nil, nil, false
	)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'SymbolDebuff')
	self:apply_option(param)
end

function field_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then break end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특능 발동 여부
				self.activate_special_option = true
			else
				--- 전용무기 옵션 발동 여부
				self.activate_cwp_option = true
				--- 특능 버프 정보
				self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'SymbolDebuff')
				self.resist_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
			end

		until true
	end
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 최초 폭발 판정
	self.collision_info.Radius = self.first_radius

	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
	)
	--- 스테미나 브레이크 데미지 배율
	modifier = modifier * self.break_modifier

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
	--- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
	for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info)

		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.resist_debuff_info)
		end
	end

	--- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	local random_x = random_util.get_random_value() * 2 - 1
	local random_z = random_util.get_random_value() * 2 - 1
	local random_dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector(random_x, 0, random_z))
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit_break', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos), random_dir_vector)
	--- 자탄 폭발음
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit_break')
	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.15)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.delay) then
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.35)
		--- 두번째 폭발 판정
		self.collision_info.Radius = self.second_radius

		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
		)
		--- 스테미나 브레이크 데미지 배율
		modifier = modifier * self.break_modifier

		--- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
			--- 데미지 처리
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale)
			--- 기본 공격력 감소 문양 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info)
			--- 공격력 저항 적용
			if self.activate_cwp_option then
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.resist_debuff_info)
			end
		end

		--- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 무기 투사체 구분 목적의 테이블
	self.atk_type = {
		normal_atk = 1,
		break_atk = 2
	}

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine


end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.break_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.break_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded() and
		CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.CartridgeIsLoaded
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 일반 공격중엔 무빙이 가능하고 브레이크때는 이동 불가
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, false
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 브레이크 공격 여부
	if discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) then
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.atk_type.break_atk)
	else
		--- 일반탄
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.atk_type.normal_atk)
	end

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 1 = 일반탄, 2 = 브레이크. 없으면 적중시 폭발 처리
	if trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	else
		--- 브레이크 탄인 경우 float 더미값 넘겨서 처리
		if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) == false then
			self.action_state:on_explosion(info)
		else
			self.field_state:sync(info)
			self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
		end
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('ManualGolemRiderBattleAction')

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 골렘 라이더 알레프(golem_rider) 메뉴얼 액션
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	--- 대상을 추격할 최대 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	self.pooled_smoke_fx = {}

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.sync_target = nil
	--- 싱크된 타겟 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil

	--region state members region
	do
		--- 내부 스테이트 정의
		self.state = {
			--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
			none = {
				id = 1,
				enter = function(prev_state) end,
				exit = function(next_state) end,
				update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
			},
			--- 강타 상태
			smash = {
				id = 2,
				enter = self.enter_smash_state,
				exit = self.exit_smash_state,
				update = self.update_smash_state
			}
		}

		---- 현재 스테이트
		self.current_state = self.state.none

		--- 현재 스테이트에서 지나간 시간
		self.current_time_passed = 0
		self.finished_time_passed = 0
	end
	--endregion

	self.is_force_canceled = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	for key in pairs(self.pooled_smoke_fx) do
		if not is_unity_null(key) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(key)
		end
	end

	self.pooled_smoke_fx = nil

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

		self.state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		for index = 1, #self.shoot_helper do
			self.shoot_helper[index] = nil
			self.proj_spec[index] = nil
		end

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		for index = 1, #self.animation_info do
			self.animation_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.emotion_info do
			self.emotion_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.preset_info do
			self.preset_info[index] = nil
		end

		for index = 1, #self.sfx_info do
			self.sfx_info[index] = nil
		end

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

----- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.current_time_passed = 0
	self.finished_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1]) * 0.8
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= dist
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state.smash)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local explosion_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	--- 폭발 요청
	self:on_explosion(explosion_position)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.finished_time_passed = self.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.action_duration <= self.current_time_passed then
		self:state_end_routine()
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine()
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region smash state

--- Smash 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_smash_state(_)
	--- set smash anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'smash')

	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.sync_dir_vector, 0.1, 0, self.hit_timing)
end

--- Smash 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_smash_state(_)
	--- cancel recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Smash 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_smash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		local offset

		if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			offset = 1
		elseif (character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= 0 then
			offset = 0.7
		else
			offset = 0.5
		end

		local init_pos = self.owner.Position + offset * vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector)

		--- instantiate smash fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'smash', init_pos)
		--- play smash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'smash')

		stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)

		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], self.owner.Position, self.sync_dir_vector)
	end
end

--endregion

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료 이거나 피해를 줄 수 있는 오브젝트에 부딪혔을때
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position)
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], explosion_position)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
		explosion_position, self.proj_spec[1].ExplosionRadius
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target, explosion_position)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier
	)

	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - position))
	local hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo()
	hit_sfx_info.hitSfxName = '02_hit_big_01'

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = hit_sfx_info

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 가우리(gourry) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualGourryBattleAction.lua')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 각
	angle = nil,
	--- 판정 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 판정 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 베기 일때
	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 판정 반지름
		self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각
		self.angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

		local info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.radius, self.angle, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)

		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	--- 찌르기 일때
	elseif self.attack_type == 'jump' or self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 판정 길이
		self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 너비
		self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

		local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width), nil, nil, true
		)

		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)
	end

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 전용 옵션 발동시 dps 배수
		local dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier') + 1

		--- 무기 옵션 발동된 modifier
		self.atk_modifier = self.atk_modifier * dps_multiplier
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play jump sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')

	--- instantiate slash effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 랜덤 밸류
		local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 3

		if value < 1 then
			--- 재생할 보이스 선택
			local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
				CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
				value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

			---보이스 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
		end
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, false, 0
		)

		if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
			character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, self.hit_timing - self.dash_timing, (self.hit_timing - self.dash_timing) * 0.5)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing - 0.1) then
		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 중심 위치
		local center_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- to 4-way vector
		local vector_4way = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)

		--- 베기인 경우
		if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
			--- instantiate slash effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', center_pos, vector_4way)

		--- 점프인 경우
		elseif self.attack_type == 'jump' then
			local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

			local flip = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			local key = flip and 'flip' or 'slash'

			local pos = center_pos + 1.1 * vector_4way

			if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				pos = pos + 0.1 * vector_4way
			end

			--- instantiate slash effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, key, pos, vector_4way)

		--- 쩨르기인 경우
		elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
			--- instantiate slash effect
			local slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'slash', character_util.get_position(self.owner), vector_4way
			)

			--- set direction
			local setter = slash:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
			setter:SetActiveByDirection(vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
		end

		--- get modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_4way)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.06, 0.1)
		else
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.24, 0.17)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 대상 방향
		damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
		--- 넉백 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info, knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		damage_info.direction = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
		--- 넉백 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info, knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * 1.2)
	end

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 천계의 검 엔지 (guardian_angel) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualGuardianAngelBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 정의된 액션 유형
	action_type = nil,
	--- 이 액션의 공격 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,

	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 판정 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 종료 타이밍
	attack_end_timing = nil,
	--- hit 방식 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 거리
	attack_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 역할 액션 버프 id
	role_buff_id = nil,
	--- 역할 액션 버프 적용 중 dps 배수
	transform_multiplier = nil,

	--- 전무 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,

	cwp_debuff_info = nil,
