	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 정의된 액션 유형
	self.action_type = {
		bash = 1,
		cross = 2,
		slash = 3,
		strike = 4
	}

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_distance = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 이 액션의 공격 유형
	local attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type]

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.bash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 타격 횟수를 1로 고정
		self.max_hit = 1
		--- 판정 시작 시점
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속 시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 판정 종료 타이밍
		self.attack_end_timing = self.attack_timing + attack_duration

		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		--- 판정 오프셋
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, attack_duration)
		--- 판정 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hittable dist
		self.hittable_dist = dash_distance * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.cross then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 타격 횟수
		self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

		--- 판정 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		--- 판정 크기
		local size = vector(length, height, width)

		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
		--- 판정 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable dist
		self.hittable_dist = dash_distance * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 타격 횟수
		self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
		--- 공격 거리
		self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height)
		--- 판정 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable dist
		self.hittable_dist = self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	self:parsing_role_action(param)
end

---- parsing role action data
function action_state_class:parsing_role_action(param)
	--- 역할 액션 명칭
	local role_action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'RoleAction')

	local battle_action_data = game_data_service.GetData('BattleActionData')
	local role_param = battle_action_data:GetSpec(role_action_name)

	--- 역할 액션 버프 명칭
	local buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(role_param, 'BuffName')
	--- 역할 액션 버프 id
	self.role_buff_id = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(buff_name).Id
	--- 역할 액션 버프 적용 중 dps 배수
	self.transform_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(role_param, 'ManualDpsMultiplier') + 1

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(role_param, 'OptionId')
	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 전무 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 역할 액션 버프 적용 중 부여할 디버프
		self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'ManualDebuff')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	--- 마지막 공격은 액션에서 제어하지 않는다.
	return self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.strike
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 강화 여부
	self.is_enhanced = trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_enhanced and 'attack_ex' or 'attack')
	--- 이모션 설정
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')

	--- 타격 시 카메라 쉐이킹 여부
	self.camera_shake_on_hit = self.attack_type == self.action_type.bash

	--- strike 전용 연출
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike then
		--- 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
		--- 보이스 출력
		battle_util.play_voice_in_args(self.cs_action, 1, character_voice_type.attack_1, character_voice_type.attack_2, character_voice_type.attack_3)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 실드 이펙트가 남은경우의 처리
	if self.shield_fx then
		--- 이펙트 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shield_fx)
		self.shield_fx = nil
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil

		--- 이펙트 위치
		local effect_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
		--- 실드 소멸 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attackend_ex' or 'attackend', effect_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	--- 이모션 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 있는 동안 방향을 틀어줌
	if self.target then
		--- 마지막 공격은 대상을 계속 쫓아본다
		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike or old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
			self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end
	end

	--- 마지막 공격은 대시하지 않는다.
	if self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.strike and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	--- 세부 판정 처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.bash then
		self:update_bash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.cross then
		self:update_cross(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike then
		self:update_strike(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중의 경우 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset)

		--- 판정 처리
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
		--- 대상이 하나 이상 있는 경우만 처리
		if #fo_list > 0 then
			--- 이 기술의 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- 대상 순회
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, self.is_enhanced)
			end

			--- 방패치기는 처음 타격한 경우에 쉐이킹을 한다.
			if self.camera_shake_on_hit then
				self.camera_shake_on_hit = false
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.is_enhanced and 0.14 or 0.12, 0.1)
			end
		end

		--- 판정이 끝난 상태라면 종료한다.
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_bash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
		--- 실드 이펙트 출력
		self.shield_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attack_ex' or 'attack', target_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
		--- 트레일 이펙트 출력
		self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'trail_ex' or 'trail', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.is_enhanced and 0.09 or 0.07, 0.1)

		--- 판정 초기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 이펙트가 있으면 위치를 갱신한다.
	if self.trail_fx then
		--- 이펙트 위치
		local effect_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
		--- 트레일 갱신
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, effect_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 종료 시점에 이펙트 정리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_end_timing) then
		--- 이펙트 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shield_fx)
		self.shield_fx = nil
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil

		--- 이펙트 위치
		local effect_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
		--- 실드 소멸 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attackend_ex' or 'attackend', effect_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attack_ex' or 'attack', target_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
		--- 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.is_enhanced and 0.12 or 0.1, 0.2)

		--- 판정 초기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_cross(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 체크할 시점이 아니라면 생략함
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- 첫타에는 이펙트 출력
		if idx == 1 then
			--- 이펙트 출력
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attack_ex' or 'attack', target_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)
			--- 사운드 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
		end
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.is_enhanced and 0.09 or 0.07, 0.12)

		--- 이번 프레임 동안 범위 안에 있는 대상을 추린다.
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 이 기술의 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, self.is_enhanced)
		end
	until true end
end

function action_state_class:update_strike(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 첫 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		self.target_pos = nil

		if self.target and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
		end

		--- 대상이 없거나 거리가 너무 벌어진 경우
		if not self.target_pos then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range
		end

		--- 지면으로 위치를 스냅함
		self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
		--- 지난 시간 초기화
		self.strike_time_passed = 0

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.is_enhanced and 'attack_ex' or 'attack', self.target_pos)
		--- 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'attack', self.target_pos)
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.is_enhanced and 0.15 or 0.13, 0.2)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_always(dt)
	--- 저격이 된 상태가 아니라면 생략함
	if not self.target_pos then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.strike_time_passed
	local time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

	local first_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[1]
	local escape = false

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 체크할 시점이 아니라면 생략함
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx] - first_hit_timing) then
			break
		end

		--- 마지막 타격이면 이탈 처리를 해야함
		escape = idx == self.max_hit

		--- 이번 프레임 동안 범위 안에 있는 대상을 추린다.
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 이 기술의 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, self.is_enhanced)
		end
	until true end

	if escape then
		self.target_pos = nil
		self.strike_time_passed = nil
	else
		self.strike_time_passed = time_passed
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_enhanced)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = is_enhanced and modifier * self.transform_multiplier or modifier

	--- 방패만 착용한 상태의 처리
	if character_util.get_dps(self.owner) == 0 then
		--- 방어력 무시
		damage_info.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.ignore_defense
		--- 데미지 1
		damage_info.ice_damage = 1
	end

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 이펙트 추가
	damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
		self.action, is_enhanced and 'hit_ex' or 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(target), nil, parent_follow_flag.none
	)
	--- 사운드 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, is_enhanced and 'hit_ex' or 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 강화가 적용되지 않았다면 생략함
	if not self.activate_cwp_option or not is_enhanced then
		return
	end

	--- 대상에게 디버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 버프가 걸려있는지 체크
	if character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(self.owner, self.action_state.role_buff_id) then
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, 1)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.action_state then self.action_state:update_always(dt) end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 하프 뱀파이어 프리실라(half_vampire) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualHalfVampireBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	local action_duration = not self.state.is_metamorph and
		self.state.action_duration or
		self.state.metamorph_action_duration

	if action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 변신 액션 길이
	metamorph_action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier_metamorph = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 정의된 콤보 타입
	combo_type = {
		--- 1 타, 2 타
		proj = 'proj',
		--- 3 타
		homing = 'homing',
		--- 4 타
		laser = 'laser'
	},
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = {},
	--- 변신 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing_metamorph = {},
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 변신 여부
	is_metamorph = false,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	self.metamorph_action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDurationMeta')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier_metamorph = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierMeta')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.homing then
		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
		--- 변신 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing_metamorph = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTimingMeta')

	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 판정 크기
		local size = vector(length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)
	end

	self.shoot_offset = 0.3
end


--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		return false

	--- 3 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.homing then
		return false

	--- 4 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 가져옴
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향 가져옴
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 변신 여부
	self.is_metamorph = trigger_info_util.contains_number(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 상황에 맞는 애니메이션 키
	local action_key = self.is_metamorph and 'actionmeta' or 'action'

	--- set charge animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, action_key)

	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		--- shake character
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.06, self.metamorph_action_duration)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.laser_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser_fx, true)
		self.laser_fx = nil

		sfx_util.fade_out(self.laser_audio_holder, 0.1)
		self.laser_audio_holder = nil
	end

	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)
	--- cancel shake
	character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		self:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 3 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.homing then
		self:homing_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 4 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		self:laser_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[1]) then
		--- 상황에 맞는 투사체 라벨
		local label = self.is_metamorph and 3 or 1
		--- 상황에 맞는 강도
		local magnitude = self.is_metamorph and 0.06 or 0.03

		--- 투사체 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector
		--- 투사체 발사
		self:on_shoot_proj(label, shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, magnitude, 0.1)

		--- 변신 중
		if self.is_metamorph then
			--- 캐릭터 반동
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_on_hit_routine(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 변신 효과를 받은 공격인지 여부
	local is_metamorph_hit = label == 3

	--- 최대 타격 횟수
	local num_hits = is_metamorph_hit and 1 or 2
	--- 데미지 계산에 사용할 modifier
	local current_atk_modifier = is_metamorph_hit and self.atk_modifier_metamorph or self.atk_modifier
	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, current_atk_modifier, num_hits)

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target
	--- valid target
	local valid_target = t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t)
	--- 투사체가 LifeTime 만료로 소멸한 상황
	local proj_destruction = hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction

	--- 1 타 투사체
	if label == 1 then
		--- 대상이 유효함, 투사체 만료
		if valid_target or proj_destruction then
			--- 폭발 판정
			self:on_explosion(label, modifier, hit_info.position)
			--- 딜레이된 폭발 투사체 생성
			self:on_shoot_proj(2, hit_info.position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil, 0.03, 0.1)
			--- 투사체 만료
			return true
		end

		--- 투사체 잔존
		return false
	end

	--- 1 타 폭발
	if label == 2 then
		--- 투사체 만료
		if proj_destruction then
			--- 폭발 판정
			self:on_explosion(label, modifier, hit_info.position)
			--- 프로젝타일 만료
			return true
		end
	end

	--- 변신 1 타 투사체
	if label == 3 then
		--- 대상이 유효함
		if valid_target then
			--- 데미지 판정
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:homing_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 상황에 맞는 타이밍
	local timing = self.is_metamorph and self.shoot_timing_metamorph or self.shoot_timing

	for index = 1, #timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, timing[index]) then
			--- 상황에 맞는 투사체 라벨
			local label = self.is_metamorph and 2 or 1

			--- 회전 각
			local rotate = (360 / #timing) * (index - 1)
			--- 발사 위치
			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) +
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotate, 0) * self.dir_vector

			--- 발사 방향
			local shoot_dir = self.target and
				vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(self.target) - shoot_pos)) or
				self.dir_vector

			--- 투사체 발사
			self:on_shoot_proj(label, shoot_pos, shoot_dir, self.target, 0.06, 0.15)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:homing_on_hit_routine(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 변신 효과를 받은 공격인지 여부
	local is_metamorph_hit = label == 2
	--- 최대 타격 횟수
	local num_hits = is_metamorph_hit and #self.shoot_timing_metamorph or #self.shoot_timing
	--- 데미지 계산에 사용할 modifier
	local current_atk_modifier = is_metamorph_hit and self.atk_modifier_metamorph or self.atk_modifier

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, current_atk_modifier, num_hits)

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target
	--- valid target
	local valid_target = t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t)
	--- 투사체 소멸
	local proj_destruction = hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction

	--- 대상이 유효함, 투사체 만료
	if valid_target or proj_destruction then
		--- 폭발 판정
		self:on_explosion(label, modifier, hit_info.position)

		--- 투사체 만료
		return true
	end

	--- 투사체 잔존
	return false
end

function action_state_class:laser_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 타이밍 루프
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 첫 판정
			if index == 1 then
				--- 레이저 이펙트 생성
				self.laser_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'laser', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.6 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
				)

				--- 레이저 사운드 재생
				self.laser_audio_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'laser')
			end

			--- modifier 계산
			local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier_metamorph, #self.hit_timing
			)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 판정
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 데미지 적용
				self:apply_damage(target, m)
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.08)
		end
	end

	--- 레이저 이펙트 갱신
	effect_util.update_object(
		self.laser_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.6 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.metamorph_action_duration) then
		--- 레이저 이펙트 비워줌
		self.laser_fx = nil
		--- 레이저 홀더 비워줌
		self.laser_audio_holder = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_shoot_proj(label, shoot_pos, shoot_dir, target, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
	--- set shoot animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
		self.proj_spec[label], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[label], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, label, nil, target)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(label, modifier, pos)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, pos)

	local hit = false

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		pos, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec), bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			hit = true
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if self.is_metamorph == false and hit then
		self:role()
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 속성 사운드 뮤트
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.1)
end

function action_state_class:role()
	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, 'buff_half_vampire_role_0') then
		return
	end

	--- 캐싱된 롤액션이 없으면 탐색한다.
	if not self.role_action then
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(self.owner)
	end

	--- 역할 액션이 있을때의 처리
	if self.role_action then
		role_util.increase_hit_count(self.role_action)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 변신 상태인가?
	local is_metamorph = character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, 'buff_half_vampire_role_0')

	--- 변신 상태가 아니면 3 타를 넘김
	if not is_metamorph and self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.laser then
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

		return
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 변신 상태
	if is_metamorph then
		--- 변신 상태 체커
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 캐릭터 교체 시 투사체가 잔존할 수 있으므로 예외처리
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.proj then
		return self.action_state:proj_on_hit_routine(move_info, hit_info, label)

	--- 4 타
	elseif self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.homing then
		return self.action_state:homing_on_hit_routine(move_info, hit_info, label)
	end

	return true
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 저승사자 하나(hana) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualHanaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 시작 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 각
	angle = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 스피드
	speed = nil,
	--- 생존 주기
	life_time = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 기본 공속 1을 포함한 공속 증가량
	attack_speed_scale = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 공격 속도 증가 효과 적용 여부
	on_boost = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 공격 시작 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 슬래시
	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 판정 각
		self.angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

		--- 판정 정보
		self.info = collision_info_util.create_pie(
			self.radius, self.angle, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		)

		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info)

	--- 회전 베기
	elseif self.attack_type == 'whirl' then
		--- 오프셋
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

		local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')

		--- 판정 정보
		self.info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.action_duration, damage_term
		)

		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info, nil, nil, 2)

	--- 훅샷
	elseif self.attack_type == 'hook' then
		--- 훅샷 크기
		self.hook_size = 0.5

		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
		--- 스피드
		self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Speed')
		--- 생존 주기
		self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')

		--- 판정 정보
		self.info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(0, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.hook_size * 2), nil, nil, true
		)

		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info, false)

		self.default_action_duration = self.action.action_duration
	end

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 데이터 파싱
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되어있을때
	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
		self.activate_special_option = true

		--- 기본 공속 1을 포함한 공속 증가량
		self.attack_speed_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AttackSpeedScale') + 1

		--TODO: 2.88 버전 이후에 else문만 남기고 제거하면 된다.
		local multiple_buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BuffName')
		if multiple_buff_name ~= nil or multiple_buff_name ~= '' then
			local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(multiple_buff_name).Data
			--- 특수 능력 버프 아이디
			self.special_buff_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'BuffId')[1]
		else
			multiple_buff_name = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BuffNames')[1]
			local multiple_buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(multiple_buff_name).Data
			self.special_buff_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(multiple_buff_param, 'BuffId')[1]
		end
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 공격 속도 증가 효과 적용 여부
	self.on_boost = trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.attack_type == 'slash' or self.attack_type == 'hook'
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- target dist
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	if self.attack_type == 'hook' then
		return distance <= self.speed * self.life_time * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	elseif self.attack_type == 'whirl' then
		return distance <= self.offset + self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 대상 방향
		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

		--- extension cache
		local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
		local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

		--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
		end

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_obj = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
			entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
			dash_dist * direction
		)

		--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
		closest_obj = closest_obj or target

		local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
		local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_obj)

		--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
		local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

		return distance <= min_dist + self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	return true
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if self.attack_type == 'whirl' then
		--- set upper anim
		self:request_set_anim('action')

	elseif self.attack_type == 'hook' then
		--- 무기 이름 가져오기
		if self.weapon_name == nil then
			local skeleton_anim = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkeletonAnimation
			local attacher = skeleton_anim:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.Modules.AtlasRegionAttacher))

			--- 기본 무기 슬롯
			local default_weapon_slot = '[base]weapon1'

			--- 어태쳐 순회
			for index = 0, attacher.attachments.Length - 1 do
				local slot_name = attacher.attachments[index].slot
				if slot_name:sub(1, #default_weapon_slot) == default_weapon_slot then
					self.weapon_name = attacher.attachments[index].region

					break
				end
			end
		end

		self.shoot = false
		self.hook_hit_timing = -1

		self.action.action_duration = self.default_action_duration

		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 3

		--- set upper anim
		self:request_set_anim('action')

		--- weapon1 슬롯의 스프라이트를 제거
		battle_util.set_hide_weapon_attachment(self.cs_action, weapon_attachment_slot.Weapon1, weapon_attachment_priority.battle_action)

		--- 랜덤 밸류
		local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 2

		if value < 1 then
			--- 재생할 보이스 선택
			local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
				CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
				value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

			---보이스 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
		end
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.attack_type == 'hook' then
		self.hook_component = nil

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.hook)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.glow)

		self.hook = nil
		self.trail = nil
		self.glow = nil

		--- 어태치먼트 원상복구
		battle_util.remove_weapon_attachment(self.cs_action, weapon_attachment_slot.Weapon1)
	end

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		self:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'whirl' then
		self:whirl_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'hook' then
		self:hook_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- dash timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 1.4

		--- set upper anim
		self:request_set_anim('action')

		--- 대시 요청
		self:request_melee_short_dash()

		--- instantiate dash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dash', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing - 0.04) then
		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 1

		--- set upper anim
		self:request_set_anim('action')
	end

	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- instantiate slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector), spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector))

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target)
		until true end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function action_state_class:whirl_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		local dir_4way_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * dir_4way_vector

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'slash', center, dir_4way_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.3)

		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, dir_4way_vector)
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local dir_4way_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * dir_4way_vector

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, 2)
		until true end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function action_state_class:hook_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		self.hook = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hook', center, self.dir_vector)
		self.hook_component = self.hook:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))

		--- 이펙트 방향 세팅
		local setter = self.hook:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
		local dir = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		setter:SetActiveByDirection(dir)

		--- 이펙트 스프라이트 세팅
		local left_sprite = setter.LeftObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		if left_sprite.SpriteName ~= self.weapon_name then
			local right_sprite = setter.RightObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			left_sprite.SpriteName = self.weapon_name
			right_sprite.SpriteName = self.weapon_name

			left_sprite:Rebuild()
			right_sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		self.trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', center, self.dir_vector)
		self.glow = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'glow', center, self.dir_vector)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hook')

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		self.shoot = true
	end

	if self.shoot and self.shoot_timing <= time_passed and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing + self.life_time then
		local bounds_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner)

		local offset = math.max(bounds_size.x, bounds_size.z) / 2 + self.hook_size

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuart(
			math.min(time_passed - self.shoot_timing, self.life_time), 0, 1, self.life_time
		)

		local length = (self.speed * self.life_time - offset) * progress + offset

		self.info.Size = vector(length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.hook_size * 2)

		local current_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + length * self.dir_vector

		self.hook_component:SetFromTo(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), current_pos)

		effect_util.update_object(self.trail, current_pos, self.dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.glow, current_pos, self.dir_vector)

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, _)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target) then
				break
			end

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				self.shoot = false
				break
			end

			break
		until true end

		ifo_list:Dispose()

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		if self.shoot_timing + self.life_time <= time_passed or self.shoot == false then

			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', current_pos)

			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.15)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
				current_pos, self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
			)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					self:apply_damage(target)
					break
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			self.hook_hit_timing = time_passed

			self:request_melee_short_dash()

			self.action.action_duration = self.hook_hit_timing + self.dash_duration + 0.1
		end
	end

	if self.hook_hit_timing > 0 and self.hook then
		local target_pos = self.trail.transform.localPosition

		local bounds_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner)
		local offset = math.max(bounds_size.x, bounds_size.z) / 2 + self.hook_size

		self.hook_component:SetFromTo(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + offset * self.dir_vector, target_pos)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hook_hit_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		self.hook_component = nil

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.hook)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.glow)

		self.hook = nil
		self.trail = nil
		self.glow = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:request_set_anim(key)
	--- 애니메이션 정보가 있는가?
	if self.action.animation_info[key] == nil then return end

	--- 공속 증가 상태
	if self.on_boost then
		--- 기존키에서 애니메이션 정보를 가져옴
		local request = self.action.animation_info[key]

		--- 공속 증가가 반영된 새로운 애니메이션 정보
		local scaling_request = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
			request.name, request.priority, request.loop, request.timescale * self.attack_speed_scale,
			request.removeAfter, request.mixDuration, nil, request.nextAnimation
		)

		--- set upper animation
		self.owner:SetUpperAnimation(self.cs_action, scaling_request)
	else
		--- set upper animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)
	end
end

function action_state_class:request_melee_short_dash()
	--- 상황에 맞는 대시 시간
	local duration = self.on_boost and self.dash_duration / self.attack_speed_scale or self.dash_duration
	--- 상황에 맞는 대시 스피드
	local speed = self.on_boost and self.dash_speed * self.attack_speed_scale or self.dash_speed

	--- 대시 요청
	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
		0, duration, speed, speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, nil, 0
	)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, num)
	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, num or 1)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	self.atk_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackType')

	if self.atk_type == 'hook' and weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner) then
		self.on_event_func = function(e)
			self:on_damage_event(e)
		end

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_event_func)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner) and self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	if self.action_state.special_buff_id and
		character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.action_state.special_buff_id) then
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, 0)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state() == false then
		if self.action_state.on_boost then
			dt = dt * self.action_state.attack_speed_scale
		end

		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		local info = e.Info
		local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(info.sender, self.owner) and
			info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type and info.hitEffect ~= nil then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
			heal_info.sender = self.owner
			heal_info.target = self.owner
			heal_info.heal = info:GetTotalDamage()

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')

	--- 찌르기 공격일 경우
	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then

		self.distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Length')
		--- 찌르기 폭
		self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width')

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()

		info.Size = vector(self.distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width)
		info.IsCenterToSide = true
		info.Duration = self.action_duration
		info.DamageTerm = 0.1

		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info, true, self.hit_timing, 2)

	--- 베기 공격일 경우
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then

		info.Duration = math.max(self.hit_timing + self.dash_duration, self.action_duration * 0.5)

	do
