--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
	)

	local addtional_dist = self.distance * 0.8

	if self.attack_type == 'wave' then
		addtional_dist = addtional_dist * 0.5
	end

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + addtional_dist
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 옵션이 발동된 상태
	if self.cwp_activate_option and character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_id) then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	for key in pairs(self.hit_target) do
		self.hit_target[key] = nil
	end

	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state[self.attack_type])
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.finished_time_passed = self.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.action_duration <= self.current_time_passed then
		self:state_end_routine()
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine()
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region wave state

--- Wave 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_wave_state(_)
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.pass_crash_behaviour

	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		0.1, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0
	)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 초기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

--- Wave 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_wave_state(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil
end

--- Wave 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_wave_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- instantiate wave fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'wave', self.owner.Position, self.sync_dir_vector)

		--- instantiate slash fx
		local slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		if slash then
			if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				slash.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1 , 1)
			else
				slash.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1 , 1)
			end
		end

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')

		--- set action anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'wave')

		--- play wave sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'wave')

		stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)
	end

	--- 가르기 판정
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		self:update_calculator(
			self.calculator, dt, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.attack_modifier / 3
		)
	end
end

--endregion

--region stomp state

--- Stomp 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_stomp_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action')

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,

	)

--- Stomp 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_stomp_state(_)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Stomp 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_stomp_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		local stomp_position = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector

		--- instantiate stomp fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'stomp', self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector)
		--- play stomp sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'stomp')

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, stomp_position)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		self:update_calculator(self.calculator, dt, stomp_position, stomp_position, self.attack_modifier, 12000)

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.1, 0.1)
	end
end

--region slash state

--- Slash 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_slash_state(_)
	--- 4-way atk
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play slash sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')
	--- 추가 sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'add')

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		self.hit_timing, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0
	)

	--- to 4-way vector3
	self.sync_dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 초기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

--- Slash 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_slash_state(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Slash 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_slash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing - 0.02) then
		--- set slash anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action,'slash')

		--- instantiate slash fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'slash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.2 * self.sync_dir_vector,
			self.sync_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)
	end

	--- 공격이 진행 중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		self:update_calculator(
			self.calculator, dt,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.attack_modifier, 16000
		)
	end
end

--endregion

--- 충돌체 계산기 업데이트
--- @param calculator any 사용할 충돌체 계산기
--- @param calc_position any 갱신할 충돌체 계산기의 위치
--- @param hit_position any 데미지를 준 위치
--- @param modifier number 데미지 계수
--- @param knock_back_force number 넉백 계수
--- @param knock_back_dir_vector any 넉백 방향
function local_class:update_calculator(
	calculator, dt, calc_position, hit_position, modifier,
	knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector
)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, calc_position)

	--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target, hit_position, modifier, knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 공격 완료 (충돌체 계산기 종료)
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(
	target, position, modifier, knock_back_force, knock_back_dir_vector
)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, modifier)
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	if knock_back_force then
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(knock_back_dir_vector, dir_vector)
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_force
	end

	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		if self.hit_target[target] == nil then
			self.hit_target[target] = true

			self:apply_shield(result_info, true)

			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info, false, false)

			--- 추가타 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(target))

			--- play hit sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'hit')
		else
			self:apply_shield(result_info, false)
		end
	end

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

function local_class:apply_shield(result_info, visible)
	if result_info then
		buff_util.add_drain_shield(self.owner, self.owner, result_info:GetTotalDamage(), self.shield_multiplier, visible)
	end
end

--endregion

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, option_param, _, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, false)

		self.shield_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShieldMultiplier')

		self:apply_myth_option(cs_action, option_param)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(cs_action, params)

	--전무 개화 분기
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(params, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	--- parsing each info
	_, _, self.preset_info, _ = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, myth_param, _, _, self.preset_info, _
	)

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_param, false)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 비취 주술사 타샤 (jade_shaman) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualJadeShamanBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		backslash = 2,
		thrust = 3
	}

	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 1타 베기

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- attack duration
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, attack_duration)
		--- 반달모양 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		--- 2타 역베기

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- attack duration
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, attack_duration)
		--- 반달모양 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
		--- 3타 찌르기

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- attack duration
		self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 방깎 표식 디버프
		self.symbol_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'DeBuff')

		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(length, height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, self.attack_duration, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

		else
			--- 무기옵션 적용시
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 방깎 표식 디버프 오버라이드
			if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
				self.symbol_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'DeBuff')
			end
		end
	until true end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 공격 구현부
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
		self:update_thrust(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	end
end

--- 1, 2타 베기, 역베기
function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 요청
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.07)
	end


	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.19) then
		--- slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
		--- play attack sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중에는 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 판정 종료될 상태라면 종료 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 3타 찌르기
function action_state_class:update_thrust(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- IK 세팅
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- 대시 요청
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.07) then
		--- dash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector,
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play attack sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.1)
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중에는 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회, 버프 및 데미지 부여
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.symbol_buff_info)
			end
		end

		--- 판정 종료될 상태라면 종료 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c

local local_class = newclass('ManualJadeSpiritBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수

	--- 대상 탐색 범위

	--- 공격 타이밍

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 투사체 최대거리
	local proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- hitabble distance
	self.hittable_dist = proj_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		backslash = 2
	}

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 1타 베기
		--- AI 보정 버프 추가..
		local ai_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'AIBuff')
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(summonable_util.get_master(self.owner), self.owner, ai_buff_info)
	end

	self:apply_option(param)
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local hittable_dist = self.hittable_dist

	local width = projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_width(self.proj_spec[1])
	local height = projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_height(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 투사체 크기를 기반으로 바운드 생성. 투사체의 높이는 0.25 로 하드코딩 되어있음..
	local proj_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), vector(width, 0.25, height))

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		proj_bound,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		hittable_dist * dir_vector
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면
	if closest_object == nil then
		return false
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(proj_bound, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), dir_vector), hittable_dist
	)

	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + hittable_dist
end

	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1],
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing + 0.2) then
		--- slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.4, self.dir_vector)

		--- play attack sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

	--- modifier 계산

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 풍작의 신 카마엘(kamael) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualKamaelBattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end


function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 브레이크 공격인가?
	break_attack = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 타겟 수
	target_count = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 디버프 정보
	debuff_info = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 피해량
	special_dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 추가타 초당 공격력 계수
	cwp_dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	targets = {},
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 이펙트 카운터
	fx_counter = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 브레이크 힐 비율
	self.default_break_heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BreakHealRatio')
	self.break_heal_ratio = self.default_break_heal_ratio

	--- 디버프 정보
	self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Debuff')

	--- 타겟 수
	self.target_count = 1
	--- 이펙트 카운터 초기화
	self.fx_counter = 0

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		--- 특수 능력일 경우
		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

			local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)
			local target_param = has_myth_option and myth_param or option_param

			--- 특수 능력 피해량
			self.special_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(target_param, 'DpsMultiplier') + 1

			--- 특수 능력 힐량 적용
			local heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(target_param, 'HealMultiplier')
			self.break_heal_ratio = self.default_break_heal_ratio * (1 + heal_multiplier)
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 추가타 발동률
			self.cwp_option_probability = CS.Oak.HeroDataUtils.GetFloat(self.owner, option_param, 'Probability')

			--- 추가타 초당 공격력 계수
			self.cwp_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')

			--- parsing each info
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

			local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)
			local target_param = has_myth_option and myth_param or option_param

			self.cwp_myth_activated = true
			self.action.sfx_info = battle_util.try_parse_sfx_info_v2(self.owner, target_param, self.action.sfx_info, 'Myth')

			--- 최대 타겟 개수 갱신
			self.target_count = CS.Oak.HeroDataUtils.GetInt(self.owner, target_param, 'MaxTarget')
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 기존 타겟 비워줌
	for index = 1, #self.targets do
		self.targets[index] = nil
	end

	--- 타겟 저장
	for index = 1, trigger_info_util.get_target_count(info) do
		table.insert(self.targets, trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, index - 1))

		---- instantiate hit effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(self.targets[index]))
	end

	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 브레이크 샷인가
	self.break_attack = trigger_info_util.contains_number(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 스태미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- 이펙트 달아줄 transform
	local container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	--- 이펙트 위치
	local init_pos = container.position + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * vector_util.up

	--- 이펙트 카운터 갱신
	self.fx_counter = self.fx_counter + 1

	--- 타겟이 존재하거나 마지막 공격일때
	if #self.targets > 0 or self.break_attack then
		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast' .. self.fx_counter, init_pos, nil, container)
	else
		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'none' .. self.fx_counter, init_pos, nil, container)
	end

	--- 이펙트 카운터 갱신
	self.fx_counter = self.fx_counter % 2

	--- 마지막 공격이 아닐 경우 sfx 재생
	if not self.break_attack then
		---- play cast sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	else
		--- 랜덤 밸류
		local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 2

		if value < 1 then
			--- 재생할 보이스 선택
			local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
				CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
				value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

			---보이스 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
		end
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.targets[1] then
		self.targets[1], self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.targets[1], self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- 일반 공격
	if not self.break_attack then
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
				self.cs_action, self.action_duration, 1
			)

			--- 타겟 순회
			for index = 1, #self.targets do
				--- 개별 타겟
				local each_target = self.targets[index]

				--- 타겟 체킹
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) then
					--- apply damage
					self:apply_damage(each_target, modifier)

					--- apply drain
					self.action.drain_state:add_proj(each_target)
				end
			end

			--- play drain sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'drain')
		end
	--- 브레이크 공격
	else
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.125)

			--- 발사 이펙트 생성
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
				self.proj_spec[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector
			)

			--- 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector
			)

			--- 아군에게 힐 적용
			self:apply_ally_heal()
		end
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then

			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 대상을 공격 여부 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) == false then return false end

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(self.cs_action, self.action_duration, 1) * 2

	--- apply damage
	self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier, true, move_info.direction)

	--- apply buff
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, hit_info.target, self.debuff_info)

	return false
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_break, knock_back_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * (self.special_dps_multiplier or 1)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 브레이크 샷일 경우
	if is_break then
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * 0.9
	else
		if self.cwp_myth_activated then
			damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'normal_hit')
		end
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 무기 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option and random_util.get_random_value() <= self.cwp_option_probability then
		--- 무기 옵션 데미지 정보 생성
		local cwp_damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		cwp_damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
		cwp_damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.cwp_option
		cwp_damage_info.sender = self.owner
		cwp_damage_info.target = target
		cwp_damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.cwp_dps_multiplier)

		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		cwp_damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['optionhit'].PresetName,
			bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)

		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		cwp_damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['optionhit'].sfxName)

		--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
		command_util.publish_damage_v2(cwp_damage_info)

		--- 브레이크 샷이 아닐 경우
		if not is_break then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.debuff_info)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_ally_heal()
	--- 오너의 파티를 가져옴
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)
	--- 오너의 전투를 가져옴
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner)

	--- 파티, 배틀매니저, 전투 체크
	if party == nil or battle_manager == nil or battle == nil then return end

	--- 힐을 준 대상이 존재했는가
	local exist_target = false

	local members = party:GetStageMembers()

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(members) do repeat
		--- 생존 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then
			break
		end

		--- 파티원 힐 적용
		self:apply_heal(member)

		--- 플래그 체크
		exist_target = true

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 소환수 힐 적용
			self:apply_heal(summonable)
		end
	until true end

	members:Dispose()

	--- 힐의 대상이 있다면
	if exist_target then
		--- play heal sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'heal')
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_heal(target)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(target) * self.break_heal_ratio)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--endregion

--region drain state

local drain_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 흡수에 걸리는 시간
	drain_duration = nil,
	--- 힐 비율
	heal_ratio = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	drain = {
		proj_fx = {},
		trail_fx = {}
	},
}
drain_state_class.mt = { __index = drain_state_class }

--- create action state
function drain_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function drain_state_class:init(param)
	--- 판정 타이밍
	local hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 힐 타이밍
	local heal_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealTiming')
	--- 최대 거리에서 흡수에 걸리는 시간
	local drain_duration = heal_timing - hit_timing

	--- 투사체 속도
	self.speed = self.action.search_range / drain_duration

	--- 힐 비율
	self.heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealRatio')

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

function drain_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		--- 특수 능력일 경우
		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

			local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)
			local target_param = has_myth_option and myth_param or option_param

			--- 특수 능력 힐량 적용
			self.heal_ratio = self.heal_ratio * (1 + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(target_param, 'HealMultiplier'))
		end

	until true end
end

function drain_state_class:add_proj(t)
	--- 발사체 이펙트 생성
	table.insert(self.drain.proj_fx, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'drain', bounds_util.get_center(t)))
	--- 트레일 이펙트 생성
	table.insert(self.drain.trail_fx, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', bounds_util.get_center(t)))
end

function drain_state_class:force_cancel()
	for index = #self.drain.proj_fx, 1, -1 do
		--- dispose proj fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.proj_fx[index])
		--- dispose trail fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.trail_fx[index])

		table.remove(self.drain.proj_fx, index)
		table.remove(self.drain.trail_fx, index)
	end
end

--- drain state exit
function drain_state_class:exit(_)
	for index = #self.drain.proj_fx, 1, -1 do
		--- dispose proj fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.proj_fx[index])
		--- dispose trail fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.trail_fx[index])

		table.remove(self.drain.proj_fx, index)
		table.remove(self.drain.trail_fx, index)
	end

	self.drain.proj_fx = nil
	self.drain.trail_fx = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param dt number delta time
function drain_state_class:update(_, _, dt)
	--- 이번 프레임 오너의 센터
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- 드레인 대상 루프
	for index = #self.drain.proj_fx, 1, -1 do
		--- 이펙트의 위치
		local fx_pos = self.drain.proj_fx[index].transform.localPosition

		--- 센터 위치까지 diff
		local diff = center - self.drain.proj_fx[index].transform.localPosition
		--- 센터 방향
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)

		local move_dist = dt * self.speed

		--- 대상 위치에 도달
		if move_dist > vector_util.magnitude(diff) then
			--- update fx obj
			effect_util.update_object(self.drain.proj_fx[index], center)
			effect_util.update_object(self.drain.trail_fx[index], center, dir)

			--- dispose proj fx
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.proj_fx[index])
			--- dispose trail fx
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.drain.trail_fx[index])

			table.remove(self.drain.proj_fx, index)
			table.remove(self.drain.trail_fx, index)

			self:apply_heal()
		else
			--- 현재 위치 계산
			local current_pos = fx_pos + move_dist * dir

			--- update fx obj
			effect_util.update_object(self.drain.proj_fx[index], current_pos)
			effect_util.update_object(self.drain.trail_fx[index], current_pos, dir)
		end
	end
end

function drain_state_class:apply_heal()
	--- 오너의 파티를 가져옴
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)
	--- 오너의 전투를 가져옴
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner)

	--- 파티, 배틀매니저, 전투 체크
	if party == nil or battle_manager == nil or battle == nil then return end

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = self.owner
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.owner) * self.heal_ratio)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--endregion

--region local
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- drain state
	self.drain_state = drain_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- drain state machine
	self.drain_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.drain_state, self)

	self:apply_myth_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	--전무 개화 분기
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	--- 최대 타겟 개수 갱신
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'SearchRange')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.drain_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.drain_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.drain_machine)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.drain_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and
		(self.action_state.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.action_state.shoot_helper))
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 이번 프레임의 대상이 업데이트 되지 않도록 drain state를 먼저 돌림
	if self.drain_machine then self.drain_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 스태미너 브레이크 인가?
	if not discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) then
		--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
		local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target(
			self.cs_action, self.search_range, self.action_state.target_count
		)

		--- target exist
		if #target > 0 then
			for index = 1, #target do
				--- append target
				trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target[index])
			end

			--- append direction
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector[1])
		else
			--- get owner look direction
			local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
			--- append direction
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, direction_util.to_4way_vector3(look_dir))
		end
	else
		--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
		local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
		--- append direction
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
		--- append number
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 0)
	end

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.drain_state:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
