--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 기사(knight) 활 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualKnight2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 정의된 콤보 타입
	combo_type = {
		--- 1 타, 2 타
		proj = 'proj',
		--- 3 타
		jump = 'jump',
		--- 4 타
		charge = 'charge'
	},
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = {},
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 데미지 타입
	special_damage_type = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 메인 타겟 데미지
	special_dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 서브 타겟 데미지
	special_sub_multiplier = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 판정 반지름
	special_damage_radius = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 쿨타임
	special_cool_time = nil,
	--- 특수 능력이 영향을 준 대상
	special_hit_targets = nil,
--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 디버프
	cwp_debuff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 대시 방향
	dash_dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 스피드
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.jump then
		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 스피드
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.charge then
		--- 발사 타이밍
		table.insert(self.shoot_timing, cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming'))
	end

	self.shoot_offset = 0.3

	--- apply option
	self:apply_option(param)

	--- apply ascent option
	self:apply_ascent_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

			--- parsing each info
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

			--- 특수 능력 데미지 타입
			self.special_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')
			--- 특수 능력 메인 타겟 데미지
			self.special_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')
			--- 특수 능력 서브 타겟 데미지
			self.special_sub_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SubMultiplier')
			--- 특수 능력 판정 반지름
			self.special_damage_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DamageRadius')
			--- 특수 능력 쿨타임
			self.special_cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'CoolTime')
			--- 특수 능력이 영향을 준 대상
			self.special_hit_targets = {}

			--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수
			self.cwp_on_damage_event_func = function(e)
				self:on_damage_event(e)
			end

			--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.cwp_on_damage_event_func)
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 무기 옵션 디버프
			self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
		end
	until true end
end

function action_state_class:apply_ascent_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 승급시 특수 능력 판정 반지름
		self.special_damage_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DamageRadius')
	end
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
	--- 데미지 이벤트 해지
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.cwp_on_damage_event_func)
end

--- DamageEvent 처리
function action_state_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info

	--- 데미지 정보 오너 체크
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(damage_info.sender, self.owner) == false then return end

	--- 추가 효과 데미지 여부 체크
	local check_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive

	--- 데미지 타입 체크
	if damage_info.type & check_damage_type == check_damage_type then return end

	local t = damage_info.target

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) == false then return end

	if self.special_hit_targets[t] then return end

	--- 싱크 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 대상 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, t)
	--- 대상 위치 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(t))
	--- 싱크 정보 발행
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	self.special_hit_targets[t] = self.special_cool_time

	return false
end

function action_state_class:special_option_hit(info)
	--- 옵션 타겟
	local special_hit_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	local special_hit_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 타격 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', special_hit_pos)
	--- 타격 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	self:apply_special_option_damage(special_hit_target, self.special_dps_multiplier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(special_hit_pos, self.special_damage_radius)

	for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(t, special_hit_target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_special_option_damage(t, self.special_sub_multiplier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function action_state_class:apply_special_option_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.special_damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * m

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.attack_type ~= self.combo_type.jump
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	local proj_max_distance = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	return distance <= proj_max_distance * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 가져옴
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향 가져옴
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 1 타, 2 타, 3 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj or self.attack_type == self.combo_type.jump then
		--- 방향 정보가 더 있는 경우
		if trigger_info_util.get_direction_count(info) > 1 then
			--- 대시 방향을 가져옴
			self.dash_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 1)
		else
			self.dash_dir_vector = nil
		end
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set charge animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'charge')

	--- 1 타, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		--- shake character
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.03, self.shoot_timing[1])

		--- 대시 방향이 존재
		if self.dash_dir_vector then
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action, nil, self.dash_dir_vector, self.dash_timing,
				self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
			)
		end

	--- 4타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.charge then
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.shoot_timing[1])
		--- shake character
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.07, self.shoot_timing[1])

		--- 이펙트 생성 위치
		local init_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- instantiate charge effect
		self.charge_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'charge', init_pos)

		--- play charge sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'charge')

		--- 랜덤 밸류
		local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 2

		if value < 1 then
			--- 재생할 보이스 선택
			local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
				CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
				value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

			---보이스 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
		end
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.charge then
		--- 반동 삭제
		character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

		if self.charge_fx then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.charge_fx, true)
			self.charge_fx = nil
		end

		--- cancel shake
		character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)
	end

	--- 1 타, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		self:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 3 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.jump then
		self:jump_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 4 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.charge then
		self:charge_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end


function action_state_class:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[1]) then
		self:shoot_proj(0.03, 0.1)
	end
end

function action_state_class:jump_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) then
			self:shoot_proj(0.03, 0.1)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:charge_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- charge 이펙트가 존재할때
	if self.charge_fx then
		--- 이펙트 위치
		local fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- charge 이펙트 위치 갱신
		effect_util.update_object(self.charge_fx, fx_pos)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[1]) then
		--- add 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'add')

		self:shoot_proj(0.15, 0.2)

		--- 캐릭터 반동
		character_util.recoil_type_1(
			self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.35, 0.2, (self.action_duration - self.shoot_timing[1]) * 0.5, 20
		)

		--- 이펙트가 자동으로 해지되도록 함
		self.charge_fx = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:shoot_proj(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
	--- set shoot animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- center
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- shoot pos
	local shoot_pos = center + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

	--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
		self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 소멸할 상황
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		--- instantiate hit fx and play hit sfx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], move_info.position)

		return true
	end

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target

	--- valid target
	if t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.shoot_timing)

		--- apply damage
		self:apply_damage(t, m)
	end

	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj or self.attack_type == self.combo_type.jump then
		--- instantiate hit fx and play hit sfx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], move_info.position)
	end

	return true
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 특수 능력 발동 체크
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 디버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.action_state:dispose()
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	if self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.proj or
		self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.jump then
		--- 조작 방향을 가져옴
		local stick_dir_vector = battle_util.get_stick_direction(self.cs_action, 0.1)

		--- 조작 방향 입력이 없다면 보는 방향으로 대시
		if vector_util.magnitude(stick_dir_vector) > 0 then
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, stick_dir_vector)
		end
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:special_option_hit(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.action_state.activate_special_option then
		--- loop
		for key, value in pairs(self.action_state.special_hit_targets) do
			self.action_state.special_hit_targets[key] = value - dt

			if self.action_state.special_hit_targets[key] <= 0 then
				self.action_state.special_hit_targets[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.action_state ~= nil then
		return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	end

	return true
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 기사 승급 (knight_ascent) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualKnightAscentBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)

	obj:init(param)

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		backslash = 2,
		shieldbash = 3,
		stinger = 4,
	}

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	--- 넉백 계수
	self.knock_back_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackMultiplier')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 높이
	local bound_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		--- 1타 슬래시, 2타 역슬래시
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, bound_height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		--- 3타 방패 배쉬
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, bound_height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		--- 4타 찌르기
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 판정 텀
		local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(length, bound_height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, attack_duration, damage_term, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + length * 0.5 * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	end

end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()

	--- 각 공격 타입별로 로드한 히트이펙트가 달라 분기처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		return CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.IsLoaded

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		return CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.IsLoaded
	end

	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

	--- add 사운드 재생 (스코 등에서 사용 필요한 추가 사운드)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'add')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		if nil ~= self.fx_dash then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
			self.fx_dash = nil
		end
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 공격 구현부
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		self:update_shieldbash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		self:update_stinger(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- 기사 리베라 1타
function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치
		local attack_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- 베기 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'slash',
			attack_pos,
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.05)

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	local hit_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, t)

	--- 데미지 방향
	damage_info.direction = hit_dir

	--- 각 공격 타입별로 히트이펙트가 달라 분기처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.Create(self.owner, t)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(CS.BoundsExtensions.BoundaryFromCenter(bounds_util.get_bounds(t), -hit_dir))
	end

	--- allow non manual 은 3타일때만 적용
	local allow_non_manual = self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash and true or false

	--- 넉백 정보 입력
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info,
		knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * self.knock_back_multiplier,
		knock_back_constants.factor_normal,
		allow_non_manual
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 기사 전용무기 (knight) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualKnightBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스

	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향

	--- 액션 유형 목록

	attack_type = nil,

	--- 히트 횟수
	max_hit = 0,

	attack_timing = 0,

	knock_back_multiplier = 1,

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		backslash = 2,
		shieldbash = 3,
		stinger = 4,
	}

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	--- 넉백 계수
	self.knock_back_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackMultiplier')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		--- 1타 슬래시, 2타 백슬래시
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 매뉴얼 아닐때의 대시 속도
		self.non_manual_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'NonManualDashSpeed')
		--- 대시 최소거리
		self.dash_min_dist = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MinDistance')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = radius

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		--- 3타 방패 배쉬
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 원형 콜라이더 판정 오프셋 길이
		self.offset_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'OffsetLength')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = radius + self.offset_length

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		--- 4타 찌르기
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 판정 텀
		local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(length, height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, attack_duration, damage_term, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 매뉴얼 아닐때의 대시 속도
		self.non_manual_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'NonManualDashSpeed')
		--- 대시 최소거리
		self.dash_min_dist = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MinDistance')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = length

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	end

end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()

	--- 각 공격 타입별로 로드한 히트이펙트가 달라 분기처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		return CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.IsLoaded

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		return CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.IsLoaded
	end

	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

	--- add 사운드 재생 (스코 등에서 사용 필요한 추가 사운드)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'add')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		if nil ~= self.fx_dash then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
			self.fx_dash = nil
		end
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 공격 구현부
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		self:update_shieldbash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		self:update_stinger(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- 기사 리베라 1타
function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.non_manual_speed,
			nil,
			false,
			self.dash_min_dist
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치
		local attack_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- 판정 방향

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, attack_pos)

		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

		--- 판정 위치
		local attack_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- 판정 방향

		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, hit_direction)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료

		end
	end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m, is_first_hit)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	local hit_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, t)

	--- 데미지 방향
	damage_info.direction = hit_dir

	--- 각 공격 타입별로 히트이펙트가 달라 분기처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.backslash then
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.Create(self.owner, t)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(CS.BoundsExtensions.BoundaryFromCenter(bounds_util.get_bounds(t), -hit_dir))
	end

	--- allow non manual 은 3타일때만 적용
	local allow_non_manual = self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash and true or false

	--- 4타일 경우 넉백은 최초 1회만 적용한다.
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then

		--- 최초 1회만 넉백
		if is_first_hit then
			damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info,
				knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * self.knock_back_multiplier,
				knock_back_constants.factor_normal,
				allow_non_manual
			)
		end

	else
		--- 4타가 아니면 그냥 넉백
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info,
			knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * self.knock_back_multiplier,
			knock_back_constants.factor_normal,
			allow_non_manual
		)
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('ManualKunoichiBattleAction')

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 쿠노이치 스미레( kunoichi ) 메뉴얼 액션
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

	--- 대시 스피드
