action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	-- 콤보간 공통으로 사용되는 파라메터 파싱

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 정의된 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		--- 찌르기
		thrust = 'thrust',
		--- 베기
		slash = 'slash',
		--- 폭파
		explosion = 'explosion',
	}

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 판정 시간
	self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- fallback
	self.attack_duration = math.min(self.attack_duration, self.action_duration)

	--- 찌르기 인 경우
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then

		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
		--- 판정 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 너비
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

		--- 충돌체 크기 벡터
		local size = vector(length, height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, self.attack_duration, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
		--- 판정 최대 횟수
		self.max_hit = area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.calculator)
		--- 베기 (2, 3타) 인 경우
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then

		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, self.attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
		--- 판정 최대 횟수
		self.max_hit = area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.calculator)
		--- 폭발 인 경우
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.explosion then
		--- 슈터 설정
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 헬퍼, 스펙 설정
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
		--- 판정 반지름
		self.jump_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpHeight')
		--- 체공시간
		self.aerial_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AerialDuration')
		--- 쿠나이 던지는 타이밍
		self.kunai_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KunaiTiming')

		--- 판정 폭
		self.explosion_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionWidth')
		--- 이펙트 반경
		self.explosion_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 폭발 타격 시점
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

		--- 뒤로 이동하게될 거리
		self.back_dash_distance = 2

		--- 판정 최대 횟수
		self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local explosion_size = vector(self.explosion_width, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.explosion_width)
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(explosion_size, nil, -1, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, 0, 0)

		--- 공격 가능 거리 : 탐색 거리 + 폭발 폭 만큼.
		local dist = self.search_range + self.explosion_width
		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		self.explosion_positions = {}
		self.explosion_directions = {}
		self.explosion_counts = {}
		self.explosion_time_passed = {}
		--- TODO : 임의로 정의한 폭발 이펙트 타이밍입니다.
		self.effect_timing = {
			0, 0.1, 0.2
		}
	end

	--- 롤 액션 관련 데이터를 가져옴
	self:parsing_role_action(param)
end

--- 정보 싱크
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 싱크 정보 받아서 폭파
	local position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	local mirage_count = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.28)

	table.insert(self.explosion_positions, position)
	table.insert(self.explosion_directions, direction)
	table.insert(self.explosion_counts, mirage_count)
	table.insert(self.explosion_time_passed, 0)
end

--- parsing role_action data
function action_state_class:parsing_role_action(param)
	local role_action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'RoleAction')

	--- 배틀 액션 데이터
	local battle_action_data = game_data_service.GetData('BattleActionData')
	--- 역할 액션 데이터
	local role_param = battle_action_data:GetSpec(role_action_name)
	--- 추가 대미지 딜레이 타임
	self.mirage_delay_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(role_param, 'DamageDelayTime')
	--- 추가 대미지 모디파이어 보정치
	self.mirage_modifier_mult = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(role_param, 'DamageModifierMult')

	--- 전무 옵션 id
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(role_param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 데이터 파싱
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 전무 옵션 여부에 따라 파싱 분기
	local buff_info
	if activate_option then
		--- 전무 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 추가 대미지 모디파이어 보정치를 더해준다
		self.mirage_modifier_mult = self.mirage_modifier_mult + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AddDamageModifierMult')
		--- 분신 최대치
		self.mirage_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'OverrideMirageStack')
		--- 버프 정보
		buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'OverrideBuff')
	else
		--- 분신 최대치
		self.mirage_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(role_param, 'MirageStack')
		--- 버프 정보
		buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(role_param)
	end

	--- 사용할 버프 정보의 파라미터
	local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(buff_info.name).Data
	--- 분신 버프 아이디
	self.mirage_buff_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Id')
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 추가타 횟수
	self.mirage_count = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 돌진 공격 하는 경우 관통 설정
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
		self.pass_crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.PassChargeCrashBehaviour(false, false, false)
		--- 크래시 비헤비어 어태치
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
		--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.pass_crash_behaviour
	end

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 분신 사용 요청
	local mirage_event = CS.Oak.BattleActionMirageEvent.Create(self.cs_action)
	mirage_event.index = self.mirage_count
	mirage_event.valueType = 1
	if self.activate_cwp_option and self.mirage_count == self.mirage_stack then
		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
			mirage_event.valueType = 2
			for i = 1, self.mirage_stack do
				local pos_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(i == 1 and 22.5 or -22.5, unity_class.vector3.up) * self.dir_vector
				mirage_event.vectors:Add(pos_dir)
			end
		elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.explosion then
			mirage_event.valueType = 2
			for i = 1, self.mirage_stack do
				local pos_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(i == 1 and 60 or -60, unity_class.vector3.up) * -self.dir_vector
				mirage_event.vectors:Add(pos_dir)
				--- 투사체 발사를 위한 오프셋
				table.insert(self.mirage_offset, pos_dir)
			end

		end
	end
	message_system:SendSync(self.owner, mirage_event)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 찌르기 인 경우
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
		--- 캐릭터 흔들기 취소
		character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.explosion then
		--- 뒤로 대시 점프 후 방향이 바뀌기 때문에 방향 변경
		self.owner.Direction = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.owner)
	end

	--- 현재 할당된 크래시 비헤비어가 존재할때
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 디태치
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)

	if self.calculator then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 발사 오프셋 테이블 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.mirage_offset)

	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	-- 폭발 공격이 아닌경우에 이동 가능

	--- 대상이 존재하고, 방향을 갱신해야 할때
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
			--- 관통 대쉬
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
					self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
					0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale)
		elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
			--- 막히는 대쉬
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
					self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
					0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
					nil, false, 0)
		end
	end

	--- 찌르기 인 경우
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.thrust then
		--- 찌르기 관련 동작
		self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
		--- 베기 인 경우
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 베기 관련 동작
		self:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)

		--- 폭발 인 경우
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.explosion then
		--- 폭발 관련 동작
		self:explosion_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기가 시작되었다면
	if self.calculator then
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

			------ modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

			--- 폭발 공격인 경우에는 캐릭터 중앙이 아니라 특정 위치기때문에 여기서 세트하지 않음
			if self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.explosion then
				area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
				--- ifo 순회
				for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
					--- 데미지 적용
					self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
					--- 추가타 예약함
					self:reserve_damage(t, self.mirage_count, 1)
				end

				--- 판정이 종료되었을때
				if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
					--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
					area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 오너의 중심
	local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 찌르기 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')

		--- 분신 숫자별 이펙트 분기
		local fx_thrust_name = 'thrust1'

		if self.mirage_count == 1 then
			fx_thrust_name = 'thrust2'
		elseif self.mirage_count == 2 then
			fx_thrust_name = 'thrust3'
		end

		--- 찌르기 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, fx_thrust_name, owner_center, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 찌르기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust')
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'sub')

		--- 흔드는 시간
		local shake_duration = (self.action_duration - self.dash_timing) * 0.8
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, shake_duration)
		--- 캐릭터 흔들기
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.06, shake_duration)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, owner_center)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- IK 세팅
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, owner_center + self.dir_vector, owner_center)
end

function action_state_class:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 연출 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 베기 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'slash')
	end

	--- 대시 종료 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		--- 오너의 중심
		local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- 대상 방향
		local dir_4way_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)

		--- 베기 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'slash', owner_center, dir_4way_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 베기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.15)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, owner_center)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, dir_4way_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- 폭파 동작 루틴
function action_state_class:explosion_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 발사 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
		--- 점프 효과음
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')

		--- 점프 시작
		self.jump_start_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		character_util.jump(self.owner, self.jump_height, self.dash_duration, self.aerial_duration, true)

		self.total_move = 0
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing, self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed - self.dash_timing, 0, 1, self.dash_duration)
		progress = math.min(progress, 1)
		local to_move = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * progress
		local dist = to_move - self.total_move
		self.total_move = to_move

		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dist) then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, dist)
		end
	end

	--- 대시길이의 절반 시간쯤 지났을때 프로젝타일 (기폭찰) 발사
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.kunai_timing) then
		local target_pos = self.target ~= nil and
			self.target.Position or
			self.jump_start_pos + self.dir_vector * self.explosion_radius

		local shoot_pos = vector_util.up * self.jump_height
		--- 분신 수를 label로 세팅하여 사출한다.
		self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, shoot_pos, self.mirage_count, nil)
		--- 전무 들고 있으면서 분신이 최대치인 경우
		if self.activate_cwp_option and self.mirage_count == self.mirage_stack then
			--- 예상 위치에서 사출함
			for i = 1, self.mirage_stack do
				self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, shoot_pos - self.mirage_offset[i], -1, nil)
			end
		end

		--- 사출 효과음
		--- TODO : 프로젝타일 쪽에서 관리할지 고려 필요
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_always(dt)
	if self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.explosion then return end

	for idx = #self.explosion_time_passed, 1, -1 do
		local old_time_passed = self.explosion_time_passed[idx]
		local time_passed = old_time_passed + dt
		self.explosion_time_passed[idx] = time_passed

		local position = self.explosion_positions[idx]
		local direction = self.explosion_directions[idx]
		local explosion_count = self.explosion_counts[idx]

		for hit_idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[hit_idx]) then
				self.collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(
					self.explosion_width + self.explosion_radius * explosion_count,
					bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y,
					self.explosion_width
				)

				area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, position - direction * self.explosion_radius)
				area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, direction)
				area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
				for _, t in ipairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
					self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
					--- 폭발 수가 1 이상인 경우 추가타 예약함
					if explosion_count > 0 then
						self:reserve_damage(t, explosion_count, 1)
					end
				end
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
			end
		end

		for effect_idx = 0, explosion_count do
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.effect_timing[effect_idx + 1]) then
				effect_pos = position + direction * (effect_idx * self.explosion_radius)

				---폭파 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', effect_pos)
				--- 폭파 사운드 재생
				battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'explosion', effect_pos)
			end
		end

		--- FIXME : 임의로 0.3로 해둠
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then
			table.remove(self.explosion_time_passed, idx)
			table.remove(self.explosion_positions, idx)
			table.remove(self.explosion_directions, idx)
			table.remove(self.explosion_counts, idx)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:force_cancel()
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.explosion then
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.explosion_time_passed, self.explosion_positions, self.explosion_directions, self.explosion_counts)
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 만료된 상태
	local proj_expired = hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.map_hit
	--- 현재 부딪힌 대상이 유효한지
	local valid_target = battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target)
	--- 투사체가 만료된 상태도 아니고, 대상이 유효하지도 않을 경우
	if not proj_expired and not valid_target then
		--- 전반 처리 없는 상태로 만료되지 않음
		return false
	end

	--- 본체에서 발사한 쿠나이만 싱크 되도록 함.
	if label > -1 then
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 폭파 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(hit_info.position))
		--- 방향 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, hit_info.direction)
		--- 분신 수 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, label)
		--- 동기화
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 투사체 만료
	return true
end
--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 분신으로 인한 추가타 예약
function action_state_class:reserve_damage(target, mirage_count, scale)
	table.insert(self.damage_delay_counts, mirage_count)
	table.insert(self.damage_left_times, self.mirage_delay_time)
	table.insert(self.damage_delay_targets, target)
	table.insert(self.damage_scales, scale)
end

--- 예약된 추가타 상태 확인
function action_state_class:update_delay_damage(dt)
	for idx = #self.damage_left_times, 1, -1 do
		self.damage_left_times[idx] = self.damage_left_times[idx] - dt

		local is_dead = character_util.is_dead(self.damage_delay_targets[idx])
		if self.damage_left_times[idx] <= 0 or is_dead then

			--- 살아있는 경우 대미지 배포
			if not is_dead then
				--- modifier 계산
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
					self.cs_action,
					self.atk_modifier * self.mirage_modifier_mult,
					self.max_hit
				)
				--- TODO : 대미지 스케일 적용
				self:apply_delay_damage(idx, modifier)
			end

			--- 관련 정보 삭제
			table.remove(self.damage_delay_counts, idx)
			table.remove(self.damage_left_times, idx)
			table.remove(self.damage_delay_targets, idx)
			table.remove(self.damage_scales, idx)
		end
	end
end

--- 예약된 추가타 처리
function action_state_class:apply_delay_damage(idx, mod)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = self.damage_delay_targets[idx]
	damage_info.modifier = mod

	--- 기본 피격 효과음 제거
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	for i = 1, self.damage_delay_counts[idx] do
		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
end

--endregion
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		--- 스테이트 머신 비워줌
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		--- 액션스테이트에 할당된 값 해제
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--데이터 해제
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 타겟 존재할때
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 은 타겟 없을때도 기본적으로 ..
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 현재 활성화된 버프를 가져옴
	local active_buffs = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetActiveBuffs()
	local active_buff_count = 0

	--- 버프 리스트 순회
	for _, buff in pairs(active_buffs) do
		--- 버프 이름 체크
		if buff.BuffSpec.Id == self.action_state.mirage_buff_id then
			active_buff_count = active_buff_count + 1
		end
	end

	--- Pooled List 해지
	active_buffs:Dispose()

	--- 트리거 시점의 분신 버프 개수
	--- 실제로 중첩되는 버프가 아니기 때문에 설정된 한도 이하로 보정해서 설정
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, math.min(active_buff_count, self.action_state.mirage_stack))

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.force_canceled = false
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

	local mirage_event = CS.Oak.BattleActionMirageEvent.Create(self.cs_action)
	mirage_event.valueType = -1
	message_system:SendSync(self.owner, mirage_event)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- force cancel된 경우 싱크하지 않는다.
	if self.force_canceled then return end
	--- 액션 스테이트 싱크
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.force_canceled = true
	self.action_state:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	--- 스테이트 상관 없이 업데이트 돌리기 위함.
	self.action_state:update_always(dt)
	self.action_state:update_delay_damage(dt)
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

			local mirage_event = CS.Oak.BattleActionMirageEvent.Create(self.cs_action)
			mirage_event.valueType = -1
			message_system:SendSync(self.owner, mirage_event)
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

		local mirage_event = CS.Oak.BattleActionMirageEvent.Create(self.cs_action)
		mirage_event.valueType = -1
		message_system:SendSync(self.owner, mirage_event)
	end
end

--endregion


return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 괴도 루시(lady_thief) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualLadyThiefBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 두번 공격 여부
	twin_atk = nil,
	--- 발사 시점
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	can_move_timing = nil,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	finished_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class, combo_index, shoot_timing, can_move_timing)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.twin_atk = (combo_index == 2)
	obj.shoot_timing = shoot_timing
	obj.can_move_timing = can_move_timing
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.target = target
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.action.proj_spec[1])
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		if self.twin_atk then
			local target_pos = self.target and self.target.Position or self.owner.Position + self.dir_vector

			local avail_angle = self:get_avail_angle(target_pos, self.action.proj_spec[1])

			for _ = 1, 2 do
				local shoot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, avail_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector

				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

				if self.target then
					trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, shoot_dir)
					trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
				else
					trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * shoot_dir)
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
				end

				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 0.5)

				--- 커맨드 생성
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

				avail_angle = -avail_angle
			end
		else
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end

		--- 컨트롤 멈춤
		self.action.controlling = true
	end

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍 일때
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.can_move_timing) then
		--- 컨트롤 풀어줌
		self.action.controlling = false
	end
end

function action_state_class:get_avail_angle(target_pos, spec)
	--- 최대 발사 각
	local spin = 60

	--- 실제 shoot offset
	local shoot_offset = 0.5
	--- 최대각을 고려한 offset
	local offset = math.cos(math.rad(spin)) * shoot_offset
	--- 대상의 뒤쪽으로 유도 되도록 보정할 offset
	local back_offset = 0.5

	--- 발사 각도를 꺾더라도 homing 에 의해 대상에게 명중할 수 있어야 하므로 최대 꺾을 수 있는 각도를 계산
	local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos), vector_util.get_x0z(self.owner.Position))
	--- 오프셋 보정
	dist = math.max(dist - offset + back_offset, 0)

	local speed = battle_util.get_number(spec.Speed)
	local accel = battle_util.get_number(spec.Accel)

	--- 대상 위치에 도달하는 시간 계산
	local duration = (math.sqrt(speed ^ 2 + 2 * accel * dist) - speed) / accel

	--- 정면으로 날아간다 가정할 때 걸리는 시간 계산
	local est_time = math.min(duration, battle_util.get_number(spec.Lifetime))

	--- 해당 시간 동안 꺾을 수 있는 각도 / 2
	local avail_angle = est_time * battle_util.get_number(spec.HomingAngularSpeed) / 2

	--- 최대각도와 가능각도 중 작은것으로 발사
	return math.min(avail_angle, spin)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대상틀 탐색할 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	local shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	local can_move_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CanMoveTiming')

	--- 콤보 인덱스
	local combo_index = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'ComboIndex')

	--- 현재 움직일 수 있는가?
	self.controlling = false

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	self:apply_myth_option(params)

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, combo_index, shoot_timing, can_move_timing)

	self.current_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 강제 캔슬 되었는가
	self.is_force_canceled = false
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param, nil, nil, 'MythProjectileInfo')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		self.current_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state_machine and self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.controlling
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target)
	local proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	return target_dist <= proj_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	self.cs_action.ComboTarget:SetTarget(nil)

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(self.cs_action, self.search_range, false)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 컨트롤 풀어줌
	self.controlling = false

	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.current_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local shoot_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	local atk_modifier = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos + 0.5 * shoot_dir_vector, nil, nil, true)

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, shoot_dir_vector, nil, nil, target, nil, atk_modifier
	)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state_machine then self.current_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료 이거나 피해를 줄 수 있는 오브젝트에 부딪혔을때
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		hit_info.target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then

		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position, hit_info.attackModifier)

		--- 프로젝타일 만료
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position, scale)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[1]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, explosion_position)

	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier) * scale

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(explosion_position, spec.ExplosionRadius)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 히트사운드 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 전설의 용사 에리나(legendary_hero) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualLegendaryHeroBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 어그로 계수
	aggro_multiplier = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 속도 계수
	self.dash_multiplier = 1

	--- 충돌체 크기 계수
	self.size_multiplier = 1

	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 방패 던지기
	if self.attack_type == 'throw' then
		--- shoot 이후 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
		self.can_move_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CanMoveTiming')

		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

		--- 방패 튕기는 카운트
		self.shield_hit_count = 3

		--- cs projectile shooter
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

		--- 어그로 계수
		self.aggro_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroMultiplier') - self.atk_modifier

		self:apply_myth_throw_option(param)

	--- 찌르기
	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 스피드
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed') * self.dash_multiplier
		--- 대시 시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		--- 판정 길이
		self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length') * self.size_multiplier
		--- 판정 너비
		self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width') * self.size_multiplier

		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width), self.action.action_duration, 0.12, true
		)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, 2)

	--- 회전 베기
	elseif self.attack_type == 'spin' then
		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 스피드
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed') * self.dash_multiplier
		--- 대시 시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		--- 판정 반지름
		self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius') * self.size_multiplier

		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.action.action_duration, 0.12
		)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, 2)

	--- 검기
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

		--- cs projectile shooter
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

		self:apply_myth_slash_option(param)
	end

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			self:apply_myth_special_option(option_param)

		else
			--- 전용 옵션 발동
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 전용 옵션 발동시 dps 배수
			local dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ManualDpsMultiplier') + 1

			-- 개화 옵션 파싱
			local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MythOptionId')
			local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

			if myth_activate_option then
				--- 개화 무기옵션 능력 발동
				self.activate_cwp_myth_option = true

				--- 전용 옵션 발동시 dps 배수
				dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ManualDpsMultiplier') + 1

				--- json data parsing
				battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, myth_option_param)

				if self.attack_type == 'throw' then
					--- 방패 튕기는 카운트
					self.shield_hit_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ShieldHitCount')

					--- 개화 무옵 방패 추가데미지
					self.shield_additional_damage = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ManualDamageModifier')
				end
			else
				--- json data parsing
				battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)
			end

			--- 무기 옵션 발동된 modifier
			self.atk_modifier = self.atk_modifier * dps_multiplier
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_special_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 개화 특수 능력 발동
	self.activate_special_myth_option = true

	--- 개화 throw 버프
	self.special_myth_buff = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_option_param, 'ThrowDefenceBuff')
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.dash_multiplier = self.dash_multiplier + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'DashMultiplier')
	self.size_multiplier = self.size_multiplier + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'SizeMultiplier')
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_throw_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 어그로 계수
	self.aggro_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'AggroMultiplier') - self.atk_modifier
	--- throw 투사체
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, myth_option_param, nil, nil, 'ThrowProjectileInfo')
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_slash_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- throw 투사체
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, myth_option_param, nil, nil, 'SlashProjectileInfo')
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	if self.attack_type == 'throw' then
		return self.shoot_timing <= self.current_time_passed and self.current_time_passed < self.can_move_timing

	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	if self.attack_type == 'throw' or self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		local proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

		return dist <= proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
	)

	local calculator_dist = self.attack_type == 'thrust' and self.length or self.radius

	return dist <= min_dist + calculator_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- instantiate charge effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'charge', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, self.owner.Transform)

		--- play charge sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'charge')
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기가 존재할 경우
	if self.calculator then
		--- 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 찌르기 패턴
	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 이펙트 관련된 것들 모두 해지
		self.thrust_effect = nil
		self.weapon_bone = nil
		self.arm_bone = nil
	end

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.attack_type == 'throw' then
		--- 발사체 루틴
		self:proj_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 대시 루틴
		self:dash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
		--- 찌르기 루틴
		self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
		--- 계산 루틴
		self:calculator_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'spin' then
		--- 대시 루틴
		self:dash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
		--- 회전 베기 루틴
		self:spin_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
		--- 계산 루틴
		self:calculator_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 발사체 루틴
		self:proj_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing - 0.1) then
		--- set shoot animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
	end

	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)

			--- 랜덤 밸류
			local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 2

			if value < 1 then
				--- 재생할 보이스 선택
				local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
					CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
					value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

				---보이스 재생
				battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
			end
		end

		--- 네트워크 상황에서 어색함을 줄이기 위해서 오프셋을 다르게 줌
		local shoot_offset = battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) and 0.5 or 1

		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 대상에게 피해를 줬을때, 상황을 체크할 플래그
		local flag_number = self.attack_type == 'throw' and self.shield_hit_count or nil

		--- 발사 사운드 재생
		projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[1])

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, -1, nil, nil, true, flag_number
		)

		--- 대상을 비워줌
		self.target = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:dash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 돌진 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, nil, 0
		)

		--- 대상을 비워줌
		self.target = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- set thrust animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')

		--- 찌르기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust')

		spine_util.set_aim_point(
			self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		)

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, self.dash_duration * 1.25)
	end

	--- 찌르기 이펙트 생성
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + 0.05) then
		self.thrust_effect = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'thrust', vector(0, 0, 0), self.dir_vector)

		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

		local arm_slot = direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and '[base]armR' or '[base]armL'
		local weapon_slot = '[base]weapon1'

		--- 본 가져옴
		self.arm_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, arm_slot).Bone

		self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, weapon_slot).Bone
	end

	--- 이펙트가 존재할때
	if self.thrust_effect then
		--- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
		local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.arm_bone.WorldRotationX, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

		effect_util.update_object(self.thrust_effect, init_pos + 0.5 * bone_rot, bone_rot)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + 0.4) then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	end
end

function action_state_class:spin_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- rescale
		self.action.animation_info['slash'].timescale = 3.4

		--- set slash animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'slash')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, self.dash_duration * 0.75)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + 0.095) then
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		local init_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)

		--- instantiate slash effect
		local slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), init_dir, self.owner.Transform
		)

		--- 방향에 맞는 스케일
		if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, -1)
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, -1)
		end

		--- 회전 베기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + 0.11) then
		--- rescale
		self.action.animation_info['slash'].timescale = 1.05

		--- set slash animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'slash')
	end
end

function action_state_class:calculator_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- set calculator position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- set calculator direction
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- start calculator
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 계산기가 시작되었을때
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- update position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.calculator))
		until true end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 대상 캐시
	local hit_target = hit_info.target

	--- 대상을 공격 여부 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_target) == false then return false end

	if self.attack_type == 'throw' then
		if label >= 0 and character_util.get_entity_id(hit_target) == label then
			return false
		end

		self:apply_damage(hit_target)

		--- 개화 무옵이 적용중이라면 옵션 데미지 추가
		if self.activate_cwp_myth_option then
			self:apply_option_damage(hit_target)
		end

		--- throw 공격이 개화 특능이 적용중이면 아군들에게 해당 버프를 적용
		if self.activate_special_myth_option and float_util.is_almost_zero(hit_info.attackModifier - self.shield_hit_count) then
			local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

			--- 파티원 순회
			for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
				--- 사망 여부 체크
				if character_util.is_dead(member) then
					break
				end

				--- 버프 적용
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.special_myth_buff)

				--- 소환된 소환수 순회
				for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
					--- 버프 적용
					buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.special_myth_buff)
				end

			until true end
		end

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.125)

		--- 오너의 dps
		local owner_dps = character_util.get_dps(self.owner)
		--- 0일 경우 어그로 수치고 1로 고정 (방패만 착용한 상태의 처리)
		local aggro_amount = owner_dps == 0 and 1 or owner_dps * self.aggro_multiplier
		--- 도발 부여
		command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, hit_target, aggro_amount)

		if hit_info.attackModifier > 1 then
			--- 발사 위치 (적의 위치에서 발사)
			local shoot_pos

			--- 현재 옵션에 따라 shoot position 을 살짝 옮겨준다.. 이렇게 하지 않으면 3개 이상 튕길 때 타겟 잡는 대상이 매번 똑같아진다.
			if self.activate_special_myth_option then
				shoot_pos = hit_info.position
			else
				shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_target.Position, hit_info.position.y)
			end

			--- 발사 방향
			local shoot_dir

			--- 재탐색 대상
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
				shoot_pos, projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1]), 1
			)

			--- ifo 순회
			for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				--- 대상이 공격가능한지 체크
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) == false then
					break
				end

				if lua_helper.reference_equals(each_target, hit_target) then
					break
				end

				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(each_target.Position, hit_info.position.y) - shoot_pos

				--- 계산된 대상 방향
				shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)

				break
			until true end

			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 새로운 대상이 있다면
			if shoot_dir then
				--- 싱크 정보 생성
				local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

				--- 새로운 발사 위치
				trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)
				--- 새로운 발사 방향
				trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, shoot_dir)
				--- 플래그 체커 싱크
				trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, hit_info.attackModifier - 1)
				--- 현재 대상 싱크
				trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, hit_target)

				--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
			end
		end

		return true
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		self:apply_damage(hit_target)

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.2)
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local shoot_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	local flag_number = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)
	local entity_id = character_util.get_entity_id(trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info))

	--- 발사 사운드 재생
	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 투사체 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, entity_id, nil, nil, false, flag_number
	)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, scale or 1)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_table.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_table.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = target
	damage_table.modifier = modifier
	damage_table.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_table.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 방패만 착용한 상태의 처리
	if character_util.get_dps(self.owner) == 0 then
		--- 방어력 무시
		damage_table.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		--- 데미지 1
		damage_table.damage = 1
	end

	--- 힛 이펙트가 존재할 경우
	if self.action.preset_info['hit'] then
		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		damage_table.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	end

	if self.action.preset_info['optionhit'] then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'optionhit', bounds_util.get_center(target))
	end

	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_table.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)
end

--- 옵션 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_option_damage(target)
	--- 방패만 착용하였을 때는 따로 데미지를 적용하지 않음
	if character_util.get_dps(self.owner) == 0 then
		return
	end

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.shield_additional_damage

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_table.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.melee | damage_attribute_type.passive
	damage_table.source_type = damage_source_type.cwp_option
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = target
	damage_table.modifier = modifier

	damage_table.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and
		(self.action_state.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.action_state.shoot_helper))
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 기록실 서기 란 (librarian) 바구니 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualLibrarian2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스

	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 액션 유형
	action_type = nil,
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 사출 타이밍

	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,

	--- 사출 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper

	--- projectile spec

	--- 공격 범위
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 판정 딜레이
	hit_delay = nil,
	--- 판정 발생까지 남은 시간
	meteor_left_time = nil,
	--- 투사체 위치
	meteor_pos = nil,
	--- 연출 플래그
	meteor_label = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 id
	special_option_id = nil,

	--- 투사체 label 카운팅 스탭
	label_step = nil,
	--- 투사체 Label 카운터
	label_counter = nil,
	--- 투사체 Label 저장용 해시셋
