}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 액션 유형
	self.action_type = {
		proj = 1,
		meteor = 2
	}

	--- 이 액션의 유형
	local attack_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_key]

	--- 사출형 액션 데이터 파싱
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		--- 사출 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
		--- 사출 오프셋
		self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')

		--- cs projectile shooter
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

		--- 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 1

		--- 투사체 최대 거리
		local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 투하형 액션 데이터 파싱
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.meteor then
		--- 사출 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
		--- 공격 거리
		self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
		)
		--- 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- 판정 딜레이
		self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')
		--- 판정 발생까지 남은 시간
		self.meteor_left_time = {}
		--- 판정 위치
		self.meteor_pos = {}
		--- 연출 플래그
		self.meteor_label = {}

		--- 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = #self.shoot_timing

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')
	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
		self.activate_special_option = true
		--- 특수 능력 id
		self.special_option_id = option_id

		--- 투사체형 공격일 때의 처리
		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
			--- 투사체 label 카운팅 스탭
			self.label_step = 100
			--- 투사체 Label 카운터
			self.label_counter = 0
			--- 투사체 Label 저장용 해시셋
			self.label_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()
			--- 옵션 발동 체크 해시셋
			self.option_activated_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	--- 특수 능력 발동중인 proj 유형 뒷처리
	if self.activate_special_option and self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		self.label_set:dispose()
		self.option_activated_set:dispose()
	end

	--- meteor 유형 뒷처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.meteor then
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.meteor_left_time, self.meteor_pos)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	--- 투사체 헬퍼 로드 체크
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set upper anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove upper anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 유효하고 마지막 공격까지
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing[self.max_hit] then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		self:update_proj(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.meteor then
		self:update_meteor(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_proj(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 공격 횟수 루프
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 발사 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[idx]) then
			--- 오너의 센터 위치
			local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
			--- 발사 위치
			local shoot_pos = center + self.dir_vector * self.shoot_offset

			--- 무작위 핼퍼 인덱스
			local helper_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.shoot_helper)
			--- 투사체 레이블
			local label = helper_idx

			--- 특수 능력 발동 시 레이블을 설정해준다.
			if self.activate_special_option then
				label = self.label_counter + helper_idx

				--- 레이블 카운터 증가
				self.label_counter = self.label_counter + self.label_step
				--- 레이블 셋업
				self.label_set:add(label)
			end

			--- 사출 효과음 출력
			projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[helper_idx])

			--- 투사체 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[helper_idx], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, label)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.12)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_meteor(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 공격 횟수 루프
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 발사 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[idx]) then
			local target_pos = nil

			if self.target and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then
				target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
			end

			--- 대상이 없거나 거리가 너무 벌어진 경우
			if not target_pos then
				target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range
			end

			target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos)

			if idx == 1 then
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'proj')
			end

			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, idx == self.max_hit and 'final' or 'proj', target_pos)

			table.insert(self.meteor_left_time, self.hit_delay)
			table.insert(self.meteor_pos, target_pos)
			table.insert(self.meteor_label, idx)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:always_update(dt)
	for index = #self.meteor_left_time, 1, -1 do repeat
		self.meteor_left_time[index] = self.meteor_left_time[index] - dt

		--- 남은 시간이 있으면 생략함
		if self.meteor_left_time[index] > 0 then
			break
		end

		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'explosion', self.meteor_pos[index])

		--- 마지각 공격은 shake 강도가 다르다.
		if self.meteor_label[index] ~= self.max_hit then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
		else
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.meteor_pos[index])
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 판정 타겟
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 관련 데이터 정리
		table.remove(self.meteor_left_time, index)
		table.remove(self.meteor_pos, index)
		table.remove(self.meteor_label, index)

		--- 피격 대상자가 하나라도 없으면 생략
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		--- ifo list 순회
		for _, target in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end

		--- 특수 능력 처리
		if self.activate_special_option then
			self:trigger_special_option()
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 대상 캐싱
	local target = hit_info.target
	--- hit type 캐싱
	local hit_type = hit_info.hitType
	--- spec index
	local spec_idx = self.activate_special_option and label % self.label_step or label

	--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
		--- hit effect
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[spec_idx], hit_info.position)
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
		--- 데미지 처리
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

		--- 특수 능력 처리
		if self.activate_special_option and self.option_activated_set:add(label) then
			self:trigger_special_option()
		end

		return false
	end

	--- 자연 소멸이거나 충돌로 인한 소멸일 경우
	if hit_type == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate or
		battle_util.has_collision_with(self.owner, target)then

		--- hit effect
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[spec_idx], hit_info.position)
		--- play_sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'hit', hit_info.position)
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.1)

		--- 특수 능력 뒷처리
		if self.activate_special_option and self.label_set:remove(label) and #self.label_set == 0 then
			self.label_counter = 0
			self.option_activated_set:clear()
		end

		return true
	end

	--- 만료 하지 않음
	return false
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 특수 능력 발동 처리
function action_state_class:trigger_special_option()
	--- 옵션 트리거 정보 생성
	local option_trigger_table = option_trigger_util.create()
	--- 오너 할당
	option_trigger_table.owner = self.owner
	--- 옵션 id 할당
	option_trigger_table.option_id = self.special_option_id

	--- 옵션 트리거 발행
	command_util.publish_option_trigger(option_trigger_table)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.action_state and self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.action_type.meteor then
		self.action_state:always_update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- action state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 기록실 서기 란 (librarian) 메뉴얼 액션
local local_class = newclass('ManualLibrarianBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state
local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 최대 발사 횟수
	limit_shoot = nil,
	--- 발사 간격
	shoot_term = nil,
	--- 발사 위치 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 마나 리젠 양
	mana_recovery_amount = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 공격 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 공격 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}

action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 슈터 설정
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 헬퍼, 스펙 설정
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 최대 발사 횟수
	self.limit_shoot = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'LimitShoot')
	--- 발사 간격
	self.shoot_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTerm')
	--- 발사 위치 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

	--- 폭반 반지름 가져옴
	local radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 판정 정보 생성
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 생성
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	--- 마나 리젠 양
	self.mana_recovery_amount = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ManaRecoveryAmount')

	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 애니메이션 세팅
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 점프 요청 취소
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- 애니메이션 제거
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- UI 갱신을 위한 이벤트 발행
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent.Create(self.owner))
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 대상이 존재할 때
	if self.target then
		--- 대상 및 대상 방향 갱신과 함께 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 움직임을 실행해야할 주체일 경우
		if battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)  then
			--- 인공지능이 아닌 경우
			if not battle_util.is_ai(self.cs_action) then
				--- 조작 방향 가져오기
				local stick_direction = battle_util.get_raw_stick_direction(self.cs_action)

				--- 조작 방향이 유효한 경우
				if vector_util.magnitude(stick_direction) > 0 then
					--- 대시 싱크 용 정보 생성
					local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
					--- 대시 방향 정보 추가
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, stick_direction)
					--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
				end

			--- 인공지능인 경우
			else
				--- 대시 싱크 용 정보 생성
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 대상 정보 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
				--- 대시 방향 정보 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
				--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 발사 시점 순회
	for index = 1, self.limit_shoot do
		--- 발사 시점
		local each_shoot_timing = self.shoot_timing + self.shoot_term * (index - 1)
		--- 발사 시점 체크
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, each_shoot_timing) then
			--- 오프셋을 고려하기 위한 방향
			local rotated_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dir_vector
			--- 발사 이펙트 생성 위치
			local init_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset[index] * rotated_dir

			--- 발사 이펙트 생성
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], init_pos, self.dir_vector)
			--- 투사체 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1], init_pos + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
			)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(pos)
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], pos)

	--- 실제로 동작할 필요가 있는지 체크
	if not battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) then return end

	--- 대상이 유효한지
	local exist_target = false

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, pos)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- ifo 순회
	for _, each_target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
		--- 플래그 교체
		exist_target = true

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(each_target)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if exist_target then
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- 계수 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.proj_spec[1].AttackModifier)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.stun_factor = self.proj_spec[1].StunFactor
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.GauntletHitEffect.Instance

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:start_dash(info)
	--- 싱크된 타겟
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 싱크된 대시 방향
	local dash_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 대시하지 않아야 하는 거리
	local no_dash_dist = battle_util.is_ai(self.cs_action) and 3 or 0

	--- 대시 요청
	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, target, dash_dir_vector,
		0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, no_dash_dist
	)

	--- 점프 요청
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.2, self.dash_duration)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		--- 스테이트 머신 비워줌
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 스테이트 머신 할당 해제
		self.state_machine = nil

		--- 액션 스테이트 값 비워줌
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)
		--- 액션 스테이트 할당 해제
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해제
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 방향 정보가 있을 경우
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		--- 대시 시작
		self.action_state:start_dash(info)
	else
		--- 롤 액션이 존재하지 않는 경우
		if self.role_action == nil then
			--- 롤 액션 캐싱
			self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(self.owner)
		end

		--- 역할 액션이 있을 때
		if self.role_action then
			--- 현재 남은 사용 횟수
			local use_left = role_util.get_use_left(self.role_action)
			--- 힛 카운트 늘려줌
			role_util.increase_hit_count(self.role_action)

			if use_left ~= role_util.get_use_left(self.role_action) then
				--- 마나 회복
				self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana +
					self.action_state.mana_recovery_amount
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()

end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.action_state == nil then return true end

	--- 무언가에 부딪히면 폭발한다
	self.action_state:on_explosion(hit_info.position)

	return true
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 라이프 가드 유즈(lifeguard_yuze) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualLifeguardYuzeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 액션 길이 (액션의 중간 시점에 판정)
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 디버프 정보
	debuff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 생성된 이펙트
	spin_fx = nil,
	--- 이번 sequence 에 영향을 준 대상들
	hit_targets = {},
	--- 루프 횟수
	loop = nil,
	--- 디버프 계산을 위한 루프
	debuff_loop = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class, atk_modifier, action_duration, radius, debuff_info)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.atk_modifier = atk_modifier
	obj.action_duration = action_duration
	obj.radius = radius
	obj.debuff_info = debuff_info

	return obj
end

--- 특수 능력을 적용
function action_state_class:apply_special_option(params)
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	self.activate_special_option = true

	self.stack_cap = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'StackCap')
	self.each_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackSpeedScale') / self.stack_cap
	self.speed_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'SpeedBuff')
	self.defense_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'DefenseBuff')
	self.loop = 0
end

function action_state_class:apply_cwp_option(params)
	--- 범위 증가량
	local radius_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'RadiusScale')
	self.radius = self.radius * (1 + radius_scale)
end

function action_state_class:get_scale()
	local current_scale = self.loop * self.each_scale

	self.spin_fx.TimeScaleModifier = 1 + current_scale * 2

	return current_scale
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 애니메이션이 있는 방향을 보게함
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	if self.activate_special_option then
		--- 스케일 리셋
		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 1
		--- 루프 횟수 초기화
		self.loop = 0

		--- 방어력 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.defense_buff_info)

		--- 홀더가 가지고 있도록
		self.audio_source_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'speed')
	else
		--- 루프 사운드 이기 때문에 홀더가 가지고 있도록
		self.audio_source_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'base')
	end

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 시작 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'start', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, self.owner.Transform
	)

	--- 시작 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'start')

	--- 회전 이펙트 생성
	self.spin_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'spin', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, self.owner.Transform
	)

	--- set default time scale
	self.spin_fx.TimeScaleModifier = 1

	--- 트레일 이펙트 생성
	self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', self.owner.Position)

	--- 버튼 체크 타이밍
	self.check_timing = self.action_duration
	--- 디버프 루프 회수 증가
	self.debuff_loop = (self.debuff_loop + 1) % 5
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	--- 특수 능력 발동 중이라면 버프 해제
	if self.activate_special_option then
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.speed_buff_info.name)
	end

	--- 오디오 홀더 페이드
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.audio_source_holder, 0.23)

	--- 종료 이펙트 생성 조건
	if self.loop and self.loop > 2 then
		--- 종료 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'end', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, self.owner.Transform
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'end')
	end

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- reset time scale
	self.spin_fx.TimeScaleModifier = 1

	--- dispose fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.spin_fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
	self.spin_fx = nil
	self.trail_fx = nil

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 트레일 이펙트는 어색한 연출을 최소화 하기 위해 직접 위치를 업데이트 함
	effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.owner.Position)

	if math.floor(old_time_passed / self.action_duration) ~= math.floor(time_passed / self.action_duration) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.01, self.action_duration)
	end

	repeat
		--- 루프를 종료 체크
		local is_break = true

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 대상 Entity 가 공격 불가한 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
				break
			end

			if self.hit_targets[target] and self.hit_targets[target] == self.check_timing then
				break
			end

			--- 데미지 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self.action:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			--- 디버프 적용
			if self.debuff_loop == 0 then
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.debuff_info)
			end

			--- hit target 체크
			self.hit_targets[target] = self.check_timing
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 액션 종료를 체크할 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.check_timing) then
			if self.action.attacking == false or battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) == false then
				--- 싱크 정보 구성
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

				--- 상태 종료 플래그
				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)

				--- 커맨드 생성
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
			else
				--- 디버프 루프 회수 증가
				self.debuff_loop = (self.debuff_loop + 1) % 5
				--- 다음 타이밍 갱신
				self.check_timing = self.check_timing + self.action_duration

				--- 한번 더 루프해야함
				is_break = false

				--- 주기적으로 카메라를 흔들어줌
				if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
					stage_camera:Shake(0.03, 0.1)
				end

				--- 특수능력이 활성화되었을때
				if self.activate_special_option then
					if self.loop < self.stack_cap then
						--- 루프 횟수 증가
						self.loop = self.loop + 1
						--- 스케일 계산
						self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 1 + self.loop * self.each_scale
						--- set action anim
						battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

						--- 스피드 버프 적용
						buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.speed_buff_info)

						if self.loop == self.stack_cap then
							--- 홀더가 가지고 있도록
							self.audio_source_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'max')
						end
					end

					--- 방어력 버프 적용
					buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.defense_buff_info)
				end
			end
		end
	until is_break
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	local attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase')
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	local action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 디버프 정보
	local debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'Debuff')

	--- hittable scale 이 고려된 반지름
	self.hittable_radius = radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 기본 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, attack_modifier, action_duration, radius, debuff_info)
	--- 기본 액션 스테이트 머신
	self.action_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 전용 옵션 관련 파싱
	self:apply_option(cs_action, params)
end

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	for index = 1, #option_id do
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 되었다면
		if activate_option then
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특수 능력 활성화
				self.activate_special_option = true

				self.action_state:apply_special_option(option_param)
			else
				--- parsing each info
				_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
					cs_action, option_param, nil, nil, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
				)

				self.action_state:apply_cwp_option(option_param)
			end
		end
	end
end


function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.action_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.action_state_machine and self.action_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 액션은 캐릭터를 제어하지 않는다.
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.hittable_radius
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.action_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.action_state_machine then
		if self.activate_special_option and self.action_state_machine:is_nil_state() == false then
			dt = (1 + self.action_state:get_scale()) * dt
		end

		self.action_state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.action_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	else
		--- 액션 활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		self.action_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 지속 상태 종료
	self:persistent_end()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 리나(lina) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualLinaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {

	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	self.shoot_offset = self.attack_type ~= 'brass' and 0.5 or 0.2

	if self.attack_type == 'brass' then
		--- 지난번 발사 인덱스
		self.last_index = 0
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	local proj_max_distance = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	return distance <= proj_max_distance * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- update target direction
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- shoot timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- shoot pos
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- shoot projectile
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, 1, nil, self.attack_type == 'brass' and self.target or nil
		)

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.1)
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target

	--- 폭발 해야할 경우
	if projectile_spec_util.is_exploding(self.proj_spec[label]) then
		--- 대상에 부딪히거나, 소멸한 상황인지 판단
		if t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) or
			hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then

			--- on explosion
			self:on_explosion(hit_info.position, label)

			--- 버스트 론도이고 첫타일 경우 후속타를 생성
			if self.attack_type == 'burst' and label == 1 then
				--- shoot projectile
				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
					self.shoot_helper[2], hit_info.position, unity_class.vector3.zero, 2, nil, nil, false
				)
			end

			--- 발사체 제거
			return true
		end

		--- 그대로 둠
		return false
	end

	--- valid target
	if t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- apply damage
		self:apply_damage(t, m)

	--- 소멸할 상황
	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		--- instantiate hit fx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], move_info.position)
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(position, label)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, position)

	--- 타격 횟수
	local num_hits = self.attack_type ~= 'burst' and 1 or 2

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, num_hits)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec))

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, true)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if self.attack_type == 'burst' then
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
	else
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_stun)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if apply_stun then
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	end

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and
		battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.action_state.shoot_helper)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('ManualLwHalfVampireBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		return false

		--- 3 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.homing then
		return false

		--- 4 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 가져옴
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향 가져옴
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set charge animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		--- shake character
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.06, self.action_duration)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.laser_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser_fx, true)
		self.laser_fx = nil

		sfx_util.fade_out(self.laser_audio_holder, 0.1)
		self.laser_audio_holder = nil
	end

	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)
	--- cancel shake
	character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.attack_type == self.combo_type.proj then
		self:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

		--- 3 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.homing then
		self:homing_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

		--- 4 타
	elseif self.attack_type == self.combo_type.laser then
		self:laser_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[1]) then
		--- 투사체 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector
		--- 투사체 발사
		self:on_shoot_proj(1, shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, 0.06, 0.1)

		--- 캐릭터 반동
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15)
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_on_hit_routine(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, 1)

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target

	--- 대상이 유효함
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- 데미지 판정
		self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:homing_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) then

			--- 회전 각
			local rotate = (360 / #self.shoot_timing) * (index - 1)
			--- 발사 위치
			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) +
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotate, 0) * self.dir_vector

			--- 발사 방향
			local shoot_dir = self.target and
				vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(self.target) - shoot_pos)) or
				self.dir_vector

			--- 투사체 발사
			self:on_shoot_proj(1, shoot_pos, shoot_dir, self.target, 0.06, 0.15)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:homing_on_hit_routine(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.shoot_timing)

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	local t = hit_info.target
	--- valid target
	local valid_target = t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t)
	--- 투사체 소멸
	local proj_destruction = hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction

	--- 대상이 유효함, 투사체 만료
	if valid_target or proj_destruction then
		--- 폭발 판정
		self:on_explosion(label, modifier, hit_info.position)

		--- 투사체 만료
		return true
	end

	--- 투사체 잔존
	return false
end

function action_state_class:laser_action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 타이밍 루프
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 첫 판정
			if index == 1 then
				--- 레이저 이펙트 생성
				self.laser_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'laser', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.6 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
				)

				--- 레이저 사운드 재생
				self.laser_audio_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'laser')
			end

			--- modifier 계산
			local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.hit_timing
			)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 판정
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 데미지 적용
				self:apply_damage(target, m)
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.08)
		end
	end

	--- 레이저 이펙트 갱신
	effect_util.update_object(
		self.laser_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.6 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 레이저 이펙트 비워줌
		self.laser_fx = nil
		--- 레이저 홀더 비워줌
		self.laser_audio_holder = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_shoot_proj(label, shoot_pos, shoot_dir, target, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
	--- set shoot animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
		self.proj_spec[label], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[label], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, label, nil, target)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(label, modifier, pos)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, pos)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		pos, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec), bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 속성 사운드 뮤트
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.1)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 캐릭터 교체 시 투사체가 잔존할 수 있으므로 예외처리
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	--- 1, 2 타
	if self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.proj then
		return self.action_state:proj_on_hit_routine(move_info, hit_info, label)

		--- 4 타
	elseif self.action_state.attack_type == self.action_state.combo_type.homing then
		return self.action_state:homing_on_hit_routine(move_info, hit_info, label)
	end

	return true
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 콜라보 마암 (maam) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualMaamBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk_modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
