---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 판정 시간
	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- fallback
	attack_duration = math.min(attack_duration, self.action_duration)

	--- 공격 유형 목록
	self.attack_type = {
		punch = 1,
		charge = 2,
		--- 완전히 분리되있어서 사용할 일은 없지만 일단 설정해 둠
		rush = 3
	}

	--- 공격 유형에 따른 파싱 분기
	local attack_type_string = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	self.current_attack_type = self.attack_type[attack_type_string]

	if self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.punch then
		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	else
		--- width
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- length
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		local size = vector(length, height, width)

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_duration, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 이전까지
	if old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 대상 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 막히는 대쉬
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 공격 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 오너의 중심
		local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- 방향에 따른 이펙트 키 분기
		local attack_key = 'attack'
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		if self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.punch and (look_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Left) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			attack_key = 'attackrev'
		end

		--- 공격 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, attack_key, owner_center, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
		--- 카메라 쉐이킹
		if self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.charge then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)
		else
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, owner_center)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기가 시작되었다면
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end

		--- 판정이 종료되었을때
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 피격 효과음
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function rush_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 마지막 공격 이전까지
	if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing[self.max_hit] then
		--- 대상 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 이펙트 방향 갱신
	if self.rush_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.rush_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

			--- 첫 타에는 이펙트 생성
			if idx == 1 then
				--- 타격 이펙트 생성
				--- 어처피 방향을 돌려야 하기 때문에 Transform 세팅은 제외한다.
				self.rush_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action,
					'attack',
					owner_center,
					self.dir_vector
				)
			end
			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
			--- 카메라 쉐이킹
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.1)

			local anim_key = idx % 2 > 0 and 'attack' or 'attackrev'
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

			--- 계산기 셋업
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, owner_center)
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- ifo 순회
			for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
			end

			--- 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	local attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackType')
	if attack_type ~= 'rush' then
		--- action state
		self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	else
		--- rush state
		self.action_state = rush_state_class:new(self, params)
	end
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

		--- 쿨타임 체크용 버프 정보 해지
		self.wait_buff_info = nil

		self.buff_state = nil
		self.current_buff_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

	end

	do

		)

		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end

	self.cs_action = nil

----- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.current_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 현재 모드를 가져옴
	local cur_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)

	if cur_mode == self.mode.shoot then
		--- extension cache
		local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
		--- 현재 모드를 기준으로 계산
		local shoot_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[cur_mode])
		--- 대상 방향
		local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
		local proj_spec_p2w = projectile_spec_util.get_p2w(self.proj_spec[cur_mode])

		local proj_size = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(
			projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_width(self.proj_spec[cur_mode]) * proj_spec_p2w,
			0.25,
			projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_height(self.proj_spec[cur_mode]) * proj_spec_p2w);
		local proj_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.owner.Position, proj_size)

		local move_vector = math.min(shoot_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale,
				self.search_range[cur_mode]) * dir_vector
		local normal_vector = move_vector.normalized;
		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(normal_vector.z, normal_vector.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg;

		local obb_bound = bounds_util.get_obb_bounds(proj_bounds.center, proj_size, angle);

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegmentWithCheckBlock(
				obb_bound,
				entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
				move_vector,
				field:IsOnUpperFloor(self.owner.Position),
				CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle,
				false,
				false
		)

		return lua_helper.reference_equals(closest_object, target)

	elseif cur_mode == self.mode.sniper then
		--- 현재 모드를 기준으로 계산
		local sniper_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[cur_mode])

		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target) <=
			math.min(sniper_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale, self.search_range[cur_mode])
	end

	--- 두 모드가 아니라면 강제로 리셋
	multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, 0)

	return false
end

--- 배틀액션 캔슬
function local_class:cancel()
	if self.current_state.id ~= self.state.none.id then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		if self.cs_action.IsActive then
			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false

			--- publish cancel event
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- state update
	self:on_state_update(dt)

	--- 버튼이 눌러진 상황
	if self.attacking then
		--- 현재 액션이 공격 가능하고, 현재 모드가 조건을 만족하고, persistent 액션이 사용 가능한지
		if self:is_available() and self:is_mode_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			self:on_action_available()

function local_class:is_mode_available()
	--- 현재 모드를 가져옴
	local cur_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)

	if battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 1번 모드
	if cur_mode == self.mode.shoot then
		battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
		--- start action
		return true
	end

	--- 2번 모드의 경우 스태미나가 명확하게 필요양 이상 있을때 사용이 가능
	if cur_mode == self.mode.sniper then
		--- 현재 스태미나
		local stamina = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Stamina

		if stamina >= discrete_stamina_action_util.get_stamina_per_action(self.cs_action) then
			battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
			return true
		else
			battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'damaged')

			local floating_text = CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(self.owner)

			if floating_text then
				local text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('mecha_android_not_enough_stamina')
				floating_text:ActivateForManaEmptyText(text, 0, unity_class.color.red)
			end

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionUnavailableEvent.Create(self.owner))
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
function local_class:on_state_update(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 현재 모드를 가져옴
	local cur_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)
	local range = self.search_range[cur_mode]

	--- 원거리 대상 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)

	--- 발사한 모드 Sync / 싱크 받은 시점의 모드와 상관 없이 이 모드를 사용해야함
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, cur_mode)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- number가 있다면 state와 연관
	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
		self.is_force_canceled = false

		--- sync target
		self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)

		--- sync dir vector
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		--- sync mode
		self.sync_mode = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)
		--- set mode
		multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, self.sync_mode)

		--- state change
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	else
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		self:shoot_proj(2, shoot_pos, dir_vector)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.1)

		local dynamic_dash_duration = battle_util.get_dash_duration_until_wall(self.owner, 0.25, 8, dir_vector)

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, nil, -dir_vector, 0, dynamic_dash_duration, 8, 8,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

--- 다음 모드로 넘어감
function local_class:toggle_mode()
	local current_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)
	local num_mode = multi_mode_util.get_num_modes(self.cs_action)

	multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, (current_mode) % num_mode + 1)

	--- 액션 중이 아닐때 리액션
	if self.cs_action.IsActive == false then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'change')
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'change')
	end

	--- 스피드 버프 부여를 시도한다.
	self:apply_speed_buff()
end

--region action state

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- 스나이퍼 모드 일 경우
	if self.sync_mode == self.mode.sniper then
		--- 컨트롤을 뺏음
		self.is_control = true

		self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	else
		--- 스태미나 사용
		discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- set locked direction
	self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
	)

	--- 본 가져옴
	self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, '[base]weapon1').Bone
	self.last_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 액션 키 재생
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, string.format('action%d', self.sync_mode))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StaminaBarShakeEvent.Create(self.owner))
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(next_state)
	self.weapon_bone = nil
	self.last_dir = nil

	if self.sync_mode == self.mode.sniper then
		character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	if self.cast_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil
	end
	--- cancel recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 컨트롤 되돌려줌
	self.is_control = false

	--- 다음 액션이 none 일때 (액션이 종료되었을때)
	if next_state and next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		--- remove locked direction
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	local refresh_timing = self.hit_timing[self.sync_mode] + (self.columns[self.sync_mode] - 1) * self.shoot_term

	if old_time_passed < refresh_timing and self.sync_target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		--- 방향이 바뀌었다면 본 갱신
		if self.last_dir ~= vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector) then
			self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, '[base]weapon1').Bone
			self.last_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector)
		end

		local pivot = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.125 * unity_class.vector3.up
		local arm_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)
		--- update IK
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, pivot + self.sync_dir_vector, arm_pos)

		if self.cast_fx then
			effect_util.update_object(
				self.cast_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector
			)

			--- 스태미나 바를 보여주기 위함
			self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Stamina = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Stamina - 0.001

			--- 스태미나 바를 흔들어줌
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StaminaBarShakeEvent.Create(self.owner))
		end
	end

	for index = 1, self.columns[self.sync_mode] do
		local each_timing = self.hit_timing[self.sync_mode] + (index - 1) * self.shoot_term

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, each_timing) then
			if self.sync_mode == self.mode.sniper then
				--- 싱크 정보 생성
				local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

				trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)
				trigger_info_util.append_position(
					sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.sync_dir_vector
				)

				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

				if self.cast_fx then
					effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
					self.cast_fx = nil
				end

				local cur_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)

				--- 스태미나 사용
				multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, self.mode.sniper)

				discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

				multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, cur_mode)
			else
				--- projectile shoot pos
				local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.sync_dir_vector

				self:shoot_proj(self.sync_mode, shoot_pos, self.sync_dir_vector)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration[self.sync_mode]) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.attacking and self:is_mode_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self:on_action_available()
		--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(mode, shoot_pos, dir_vector)
	--- 액션 키 재생
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, string.format('shoot%d', mode))

	--- 발사 이펙트
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[mode], shoot_pos, dir_vector)

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[mode], shoot_pos, dir_vector, mode)

	--- 캐릭터 반동주는 연출
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, dir_vector, 0.3 * mode, 0.1, 0.275)
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	if label == self.mode.shoot then
		self:on_explosion(move_info.position, label)

		return true

	elseif label == self.mode.sniper then
		if hit_info.target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, move_info.direction, label)
		end

		return false
	end

	return true
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position, label)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, explosion_position)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		explosion_position, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec), bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(
				vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - explosion_position)
			)

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, dir_vector, label)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, dir_vector, label)
	local cur_mode = multi_mode_util.get_current_mode(self.cs_action)

	--- 계수 계산시 현재 모드를 가져오기 때문에 label 모드로 전환
	multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, label)

	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration[label]
	)

	multi_mode_util.set_mode(self.cs_action, cur_mode)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier / self.columns[label]
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	if self.dps_multiplier then
		damage_info.modifier = damage_info.modifier * (1 + self.dps_multiplier)
	end

	if label == #self.proj_spec then
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(
			damage_info, knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * 0.9, knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		)

		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.proj_spec[label].HitSfxName)
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.2)
end

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(_, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 추가 projectile 데이터 파싱
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, option_param)

		self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

--region speed buff system

function local_class:apply_speed_buff()
	--- 버프가 적용되있는 상태라면 무시한다.
	if self.current_buff_state ~= self.buff_state.available then
		return
	end

	--- 이속 버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.speed_buff_info)

	self.current_buff_state = self.buff_state.activate
end

--- 버프 적용 플래그 갱신 용도
function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	--- 만료된 대상 체크
	local expired_target = e.Target
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, expired_target) then
		return false
	end

	--- 이속증 버프 관련 처리
	if self.current_buff_state == self.buff_state.activate then
		--- 이속 버프가 남아있는지 체크
		if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.speed_buff_info.name) then
			return false
		end

		--- 쿨타임 용 버프 부여
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.wait_buff_info)

		self.current_buff_state = self.buff_state.cool_down
	--- 대기 시간 체크용 버프 처리
	elseif self.current_buff_state == self.buff_state.cool_down then
		--- 대기 용 버프가 남아있는지 체크
		if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.wait_buff_info.name) then
			return false
		end

		self.current_buff_state = self.buff_state.available
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 전쟁 청부업자 오르카(mercenary) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualMercenaryBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	can_move_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	self.can_move_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CanMoveTiming')

	--- 무기에서 오프셋 정보를 가져옴
	local weapon = character_util.get_weapon(self.owner)

	if weapon and weapon.WeaponSpec then
		--- 무기 오프셋
		self.shoot_offset = battle_util.get_number(weapon.WeaponSpec.ShootOffset)
	else
		--- fallback
		self.shoot_offset = 0.5
	end

	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	self.is_active_myth_option = true

	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param, nil, nil, 'MythProjectileInfo')
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.can_move_timing > 0 and
		self.shoot_timing[1] < self.current_time_passed and self.current_time_passed <= self.can_move_timing
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- update target direction
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- get center
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- ik update
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- loop shoot timing
	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do
		--- shoot timing
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index] - 0.05) then
			--- set shoot animation
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

			--- 캐릭터 반동
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0.1, 0.15)
		end

		--- shoot timing
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) then
			--- shoot pos
			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

			--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
				self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)

			--- grenade shoot
			if self.attack_type == 'grenade' then
				shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

				--- get max distance
				local dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

				if self.target then
					--- target dist
					local target_dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target)

					--- limit check
					if target_dist < dist then
						dist = target_dist
					end
				end

				--- shoot projectile
				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
					self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, dist
				)
			else
				local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
				local bounce_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector

				--- 탄피 생성
				CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center, bounce_dir)

				--- shoot projectile
				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
			end
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	local t = hit_info.target

	if projectile_spec_util.is_exploding(self.proj_spec[1]) then
		if self.attack_type == 'launcher' then
			if (t == nil and hit_info.hitType ~= projectile_hit_type.self_destruction) or
				t and not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
				--- 폭발하지 않도록
				return false
			end
		end

		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position)

		return true
	end

	if t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.shoot_timing)

		--- apply damage
		self:apply_damage(t, m)
	else
		--- instantiate hit fx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], move_info.position)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(position)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[1]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, position)

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(spec))

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, true)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_stun)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if apply_stun then
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	end

	if self.attack_type ~= 'grenade' and not self.is_active_myth_option then
		--- 기본 사운드 mute
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)
	else
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.CartridgeIsLoaded and
		(self.action_state.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.action_state.shoot_helper))
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 바다의 만물상 시아 (mermaid) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualMermaidBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,

	--- 사출 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- 캐시된 사원수
	cached_quaternion = nil,
	--- 사출 패턴
	shoot_parallel_pattern = nil,
	--- 패턴 수
	pattern_count = nil,

	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 싱크 유형
	sync_type = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 옵션 버프 정보
	cwp_buff_info = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 옵션 버프 쿨타임
	cwp_cool_time = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 옵션 적용 후 지난 시간
	cwp_time_passed = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 사출 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')
	--- 사원수 캐시
	self.cached_quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	--- 사출 패턴
	self.shoot_parallel_pattern = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootParallelPattern')
	--- 패턴 수
	self.pattern_count = #self.shoot_parallel_pattern

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		--- 액션 시작
		start = 1,
		--- 사출
		shoot = 2,
		--- 타겟 변경
		change_target = 3,
		--- 완료
		finish = 4
	}

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 공격 가능 거리
	self.hittable_dist = max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 전용 무기 옵션 버프 정보
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'ManualBuff')
		--- 전용 무기 옵션 버프 쿨타임
		self.cwp_cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ManualCoolTime')
		--- 전용 무기 옵션 적용 후 지난 시간
		self.cwp_time_passed = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info, reset_force_cancel)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 대상이 존재했었는지 여부
	self.exist_target = trigger_info_util.contains_target(info)

	--- 루틴 시작한 경우 강제 캔슬 여부 리셋
	if reset_force_cancel then
		self.force_cancel = false
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- play loop sfx
	self.sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- fade out loop sfx
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.sfx_holder, 0.2)
	self.sfx_holder = nil

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 스태미나 사용
	continuous_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action, dt)

	local start_idx = math.floor(old_time_passed / self.action_duration) + 1
	local end_idx = math.floor(time_passed / self.action_duration)

	--- 대상 및 방향 갱신
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- 현재 타겟이 없고 타겟이 존재했었다면 (네트워크 타겟 갱신)
	--- [재탐색] 부쉬 대응
	if self.exist_target and (not self.target or bush_util.is_hide(self.target)) then
		--- 원거리 타겟 검색
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
			self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
		)

		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		if self.target then
			trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)
		else
			self.exist_target = false
		end

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)

		trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.sync_type.change_target)

		--- 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	for idx = start_idx, end_idx do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, idx * self.action_duration) then
			--- 사용이 가능한 상태
			if self.action.attacking and battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
				--- 공격이 가능한 상태 (네트워크 캐릭터가 아닐 경우)
				if battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
					--- 싱크 정보 구성
					local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
					--- 사출 위치
					trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self:get_shoot_pos(self.dir_vector))
					--- 사출 방향
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)
					--- 사출 플래그 설정
					trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.sync_type.shoot)
					--- 커맨드 배포
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
				end

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			else
				--- 트리거 정보 구성
				local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 종료 플래그 설정
				trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.sync_type.finish)
				--- 커맨드 배포
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:get_shoot_pos(dir_vector)
	--- 기본 사출 위치
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + dir_vector * self.shoot_offset
	--- 랜덤 인덱스
	local random_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, self.pattern_count)
	--- dir vector를 돌림
	local rotated_dir = self.cached_quaternion * dir_vector
	--- 최종 위치 반환
	return shoot_pos + rotated_dir * self.shoot_parallel_pattern[random_idx]
end

function action_state_class:sync_proj(info)
	if self.force_cancel then return end

	--- 사출 위치
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 사출 방향
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- instantiate shoot fx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, dir_vector, nil, true)
	--- 사출
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, dir_vector)
	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.05)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(hit_info)
	--- 대상 캐싱
	local target = hit_info.target

	--- 기본적으로 hit 이펙트는 출력함
	if hit_info.hitType ~= projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate then
		--- instantiate hit fx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_info.position)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.07)
	end

	--- 특정 대상에만 유효함
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
		--- 힐 적용
		self:apply_damage(target)
	end

	--- 만료함
	return true
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = continuous_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(self.cs_action, self.action_duration)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전용 무기 옵션이 발동 중이 아니거나 쿨타임 중이라면 생략함
	if not self.activate_cwp_option or self.cwp_time_passed then
		return
	end

	self:apply_allie_buff()
end

--- 쿨타임 업데이트
function action_state_class:update_always(dt)
	if self.activate_cwp_option and self.cwp_time_passed then
		self.cwp_time_passed = self.cwp_time_passed - dt

		if self.cwp_time_passed <= 0 then
			self.cwp_time_passed = nil
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_allie_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)
	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 생존 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end
		--- 버프 부여
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.cwp_buff_info)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 버프 부여
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.cwp_buff_info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 쿨타임 설정
	self.cwp_time_passed = self.cwp_cool_time
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.action_state then self.action_state:update_always(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then

			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 위치 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.action_state:get_shoot_pos(dir_vector))

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- on_action_available에서 발행한 것임을 나타내기 위해 플래그 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action_state.sync_type.start)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트가 유효할때만 처리한다.
	if not self.action_state then return end

	--- 싱크 타입
	local sync_label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	--- 액션 시작
	if sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.start then
		self.action_state:sync(info, true)
		self.action_state:sync_proj(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	--- 사출
	elseif sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.shoot then
		self.action_state:sync_proj(info)

	--- 타겟 변경
	elseif sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.change_target then
		self.action_state:sync(info)

	--- 액션 종료
	elseif sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.finish then
		--- state reset
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 여부 설정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 지속 상태 종료
	self:persistent_end()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 방어
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(hit_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
