--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 파티 크래셔 매드 팬더단 대니 (party_mad_panda_man) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualPartyMadPandaManBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = 5

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 판정 너비
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 판정 크기
	local size = vector(length, height, width)
	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, self.action_duration - self.dash_timing, 0.2)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	self.last_hit_time = nil
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	self.dash_fx = nil

	--- 채찍 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 애니메이션 해지
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	--- 방향 고정 해지
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 유효한 상황
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, nil, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
		)

		--- 공격 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')

		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 1.2 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
		)
		--- 대시 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')
	end

	if self.dash_timing <= time_passed then
		effect_util.update_object(self.dash_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 1.2 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 충돌체에 영향받는 ifo list
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 적중한 대상이 있는 경우
		local hit = false

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t)
			--- 플래그 교체
			hit = true
		end

		--- PooledList 해지
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 적중한 대상이 있고 판정 간격에 맞게 적중했을때
		if hit and (self.last_hit_time == nil or self.last_hit_time + 0.15 <= time_passed) then
			--- 롤액션 힛 카운트 증가
			self:set_role_hit_count()
			--- 마지막으로 적중한 시간 갱신
			self.last_hit_time = time_passed
		end
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 종료 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'end')

		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_table.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_table.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = t
	damage_table.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_table.stun_duration = 0.4

	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)
	local elemental_type = weapon_util.get_elemental_type(character_util.get_weapon(master))

	--- 데미지 1
	if elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth then
		damage_table.earth_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Fire then
		damage_table.fire_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Ice then
		damage_table.ice_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Light then
		damage_table.light_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Darkness then
		damage_table.dark_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.None then
		damage_table.damage = 1
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)

	--- 히트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(t))
	--- 히트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
end

function action_state_class:set_role_hit_count()
	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

	--- 버프가 있을 경우에는 카운트를 늘릴 필요 없음
	if character_util.has_active_buff(master, 'buff_party_mad_panda_role') then
		return
	end

	--- 캐싱된 액션이 없는 경우
	if self.role_action == nil then
		-- 역할 액션 캐시
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(master)
	end

	--- 역할 액션 있을때
	if self.role_action then
		--- 히트 카운트 증가
		role_util.increase_hit_count(self.role_action)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 이고, Available 상태의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀 액션 state sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- sync 용 정보 생성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 근거리 타겟 탐색
	local _, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- sync info
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 지속 상태 종료
	self:persistent_end()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 파티 크래셔 매드 팬더단 팬더 (party_mad_panda_panda) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualPartyMadPandaPandaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = weapon_util.get_shoot_offset(character_util.get_weapon(self.owner)) or 0.5

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 액션 애니메이션 요청
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- 캐릭터 반동
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.05, 0, 0.1, 0)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 반동 연출 취소
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- 애니메이션 해지
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	--- 방향 고정 해지
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 높이 오프셋을 고려한 중심의 위치
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- update IK
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = center + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 발사 효과 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 힛 이펙트 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_info.position)

	--- valid target
	local valid_target = battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target)

	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
	if valid_target then
		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target)

		--- 롤액션 힛 카운트 증가
		self:set_role_hit_count()

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.12)
	end

	--- 투사체 만료
	return true
end

function action_state_class:set_role_hit_count()
	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

	--- 버프가 있을 경우에는 카운트를 늘릴 필요 없음
	if character_util.has_active_buff(master, 'buff_party_mad_panda_role') then
		return
	end

	--- 캐싱된 액션이 없는 경우
	if self.role_action == nil then
		-- 역할 액션 캐시
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(master)
	end

	--- 역할 액션 있을때
	if self.role_action then
		--- 히트 카운트 증가
		role_util.increase_hit_count(self.role_action)
	end
end


--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_table.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_table.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = t

	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)
	local elemental_type = weapon_util.get_elemental_type(character_util.get_weapon(master))

	--- 데미지 1
	if elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth then
		damage_table.earth_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Fire then
		damage_table.fire_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Ice then
		damage_table.ice_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Light then
		damage_table.light_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Darkness then
		damage_table.dark_damage = 1
	elseif elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.None then
		damage_table.damage = 1
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 이고, Available 상태의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀 액션 state sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- sync 용 정보 생성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- sync info
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 지속 상태 종료
	self:persistent_end()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 우수사원 파르바티(parvati) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualParvatiBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 충돌체 크기
	collision_size = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 몬스터를 통과 가능한 crash behaviour
	pass_crash_behaviour = nil,
	--- hitabble distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 디버프
	special_debuff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == 'dash' then
		--- 충돌체 한변 크기
		local size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Size')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		self.collision_size = vector(size, height, size)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(self.collision_size, self.dash_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- 몬스터를 통과 가능한 crash behaviour
		self.pass_crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.PassChargeCrashBehaviour(false, false, false)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = size * 0.5

	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 지속 시간
		local hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')
		--- 충돌체 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 충돌체 각
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, hit_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = radius

	elseif self.attack_type == 'xslash' then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 판정 지속 시간
		local hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')
		--- 충돌체 한변 크기
		local size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Size')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		self.collision_size = vector(size, height, size)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(self.collision_size, hit_duration, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = size
	end
	--- apply option
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
		self.activate_special_option = true

		--- 특수 능력 디버프
		self.special_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- target dist
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_obj = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	closest_obj = closest_obj or target

	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
	local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_obj)

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

	return distance <= min_dist + self.hittable_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 일반 공격 1타
	if self.attack_type == 'dash' then
		--- attach crash behaviour
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
		--- set crash behaviour
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.pass_crash_behaviour

		--- set last frame bounds center
		self.last_bounds_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 일반 공격 1타
	if self.attack_type == 'dash' then
		if self.current_time_passed < self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration then
			--- instantiate dash effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

			--- owner fade
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)
		end

		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 시간 이전까지 갱신
	if old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 일반 공격 1타
		if self.attack_type == 'dash' then
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action, nil, self.dir_vector,
				0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil, false, nil
			)

		--- 일반 공격 2, 3, 4타
		else
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
				0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil, false, 0
			)
		end
	end

	--- 일반 공격 1타
	if self.attack_type == 'dash' then
		self:dash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 일반 공격 2, 3타
	elseif self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		self:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 일반 공격 4타
	elseif self.attack_type == 'xslash' then
		self:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 동작중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- current modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 물체 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- loop ifo list
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- apply damage
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function action_state_class:dash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- instantiate dash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- play dash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)

		--- owner fade
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.03)

		--- set calculator direction
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 동작중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 이동 벡터
		local move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) - self.last_bounds_center)
		--- 이동한 거리
		local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(move_vector)

		--- 이동 벡터의 중심
		local center = 0.5 * (bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.last_bounds_center)
		--- 충돌체 크기를 고려하여 size 계산
		local size = self.collision_size + magnitude * unity_class.vector3.right

		--- 계산된 size를 충돌체 정보에 적용
		self.collision_info.Size = size

		--- set calculator position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)

		--- set current bounds center
		self.last_bounds_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		--- instantiate dash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- play end sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'end')

		--- owner fade
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)
	end
end

function action_state_class:slash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- set calculator position
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 히트 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- owner bounds center
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- slash offset
		local slash_offset = 0.275
		--- init direction
		local direction = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
		--- init position
		local position = center + slash_offset * direction

		--- 일반 공격 4타
		if self.attack_type == 'xslash' then
			--- instantiate slash effect
			local slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'slash', position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)

			--- 이펙트 방향 세팅
			local setter = slash:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
			setter:SetActiveByDirection(vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

			--- instantiate field effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', center + 0.5 * self.collision_size.x * direction)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

			--- 랜덤 밸류
			local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 3

			if value < 1 then
				--- 재생할 보이스 선택
				local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
					CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
					value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

				---보이스 재생
				battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
			end
		else
			--- effect key
			local key = (vector_util.to_direction(direction) & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None and
				'rslash' or 'slash'

			--- instantiate slash effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, key, position, direction, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)
		end

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- set calculator direction
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
		damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
		--- 넉백 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info, 14000)
	end

	--- hit 이펙트가 존재할 경우
	if self.action.preset_info['hit'] then
		--- hit 이펙트 생성
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	end

	--- hit 사운드가 존재할 경우
	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	else
		--- 사운드 mute
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 특수 능력 발동시
	if self.activate_special_option then
		--- 무충 감소 디버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.special_debuff_info)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 코르네 (pixy_girl) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualPixyGirlBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state
local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 일반 공격 계산용 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- shoot_helper
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 투사체 최대 사거리
	self.proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 적중 가능 거리
	self.hittable_dist = self.proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	--- 발사 위치에 대한 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')

	--- 판정 반지름 (하나 가지고 가변 세팅)
	local radius = 1
	--- 판정 정보, 판정의 시작은 지면부터.
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 방깎 디버프
	self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Debuff')

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)
		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
			--- 롤액션 버프 정보
			local role_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleBuff')
			--- 체크할 롤액션 버프 아이디
			self.role_buff_id = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(role_buff_info.name).Id

			--- 공증 버프
			self.atk_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'DamageBuff')
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 보너스 피해
			self.bonus_hit_chance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BonusHitChance')
			self.bonus_damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BonusDamageModifier')
			--- parsing each info
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		--- 대상
		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		--- 대상 방향
		self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
		--- 발사할 투사체 유형
		self.proj_type = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
	else
		self:on_explosion(
			trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info),
			trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info),
			--- number가 있으면 전무 추가타가 발동한거다.
			trigger_info_util.contains_number(info)
		)
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 대상 쳐다보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local key = self.proj_type == self.action.atk_type.break_atk and 'proj_break' or 'proj'

	self.fx_proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		key,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up,
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	self.fx_proj.transform.localScale = vector_util.zero
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_proj, true)
	self.fx_proj = nil

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 발사 직전 까지 대상 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	---브레이크 일때만 발사 직전에 반동 연출
	if self.proj_type == self.action.atk_type.break_atk and
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing - 0.1) then
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2)
	end

	-- 발사 직전 까지 열매 꺼내서 들어올리는 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.shoot_timing) then
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.shoot_timing, 1)
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_proj, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up * progress)
		self.fx_proj.transform.localScale = progress * vector_util.one
	end

	--- 발사
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_proj, true)
		self.fx_proj = nil

		self:shoot_projectile()
	end

	--- 액션 시간 만료에 따른 정리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 투사체 발사 위치는 캐릭터 머리위
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector + vector_util.up
	--- 대상의 위치
	local target_pos = self.target and
		bounds_util.get_center(self.target) or
		battle_util.get_ground_pos(shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.proj_max_dist)

	--- 발사할 방향 (코르네 머리 위에서 목적지로)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - shoot_pos)

	--- 발사 연출
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[self.proj_type], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

	--- 곡사 투사체 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[self.proj_type],
		shoot_pos,
		self.dir_vector,
		self.proj_type,
		nil,
		nil,
		true,
		nil,
		target_pos
	)

end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 히트 시점에 싱크 처리
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, hit_info.position)
		--- 투사체 유형
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, label)

		--- [전무 옵션] 50% 확률로 추가 피해 40%
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			local rand = random_util.get_random_value()
			if self.bonus_hit_chance > rand then
				--- number가 있으면 추가타 발동.
				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, label)
			end
		end
		--- 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		return true

	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		--- 지면 착탄인 경우, 랜덤 추가타가 안터진다.
		--- 싱크 처리
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, hit_info.position)
		--- 투사체 유형
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, label)
		--- 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(position, label, bonus)
	local proj_spec = self.proj_spec[label]
	--- 적중한 투사체 유형에 맞는 폭발 처리
	self.collision_info.Radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(proj_spec)
	--- 범위 내의 대상들
	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, position)

	for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 일반 공격의 데미지 모디파이어 계산
			local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
				self.cs_action,
				self.action_duration,
				self.break_modifier - 1
			)

			--- 스테미나 브레이크 데미지 배율 적용
			if label == self.action.atk_type.break_atk then
				modifier = modifier * self.break_modifier
			end

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			--- 브레이크 공격은 방깍
			--- [전무 옵션] 모든 공격이 방깎
			if label == self.action.atk_type.break_atk or self.activate_cwp_option then
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.debuff_info)
			end

			--- [특능 옵션] 픽시가 붙은 대상을 때리면 내게 공증 20% 주기 위한 체크용 empty 버프
			if self.activate_special_option and character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(target, self.role_buff_id) then
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.atk_buff_info)
			end

			--- [전무 옵션] 50% 확률로 추가 피해 40%
			if self.activate_cwp_option and bonus then
				self:apply_bonus_damage(target)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 기본 평타 쉐이킹
	if label == self.action.atk_type.break_atk then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.1)
	else
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
	end

	if self.activate_cwp_option and bonus then
		--- 추가타 발동시에만 쉐이킹 강화
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
		--- 추가타 이펙트
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[label], position)
	else
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[label], position)
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	--- 기본 히트음은 대체됨
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 추가타의 경우 기본 히트음 나온다.
function action_state_class:apply_bonus_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | damage_attribute_type.passive
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.cwp_option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.bonus_damage_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end
--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 무기 투사체 구분 목적의 테이블
	self.atk_type = {
		normal_atk = 1,
		break_atk = 2
	}

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.break_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.break_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 일반 공격중엔 무빙이 가능하고 브레이크때는 이동 불가
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, false
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	local proj_type = discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) and self.atk_type.break_atk or self.atk_type.normal_atk
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, proj_type)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션 상태가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return end

	self.action_state:sync(info)

	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.atk_type then return true end
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 역병의사 (plague_doctor) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualPlagueDoctorBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,


	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 속도
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 지속시간
	dash_duration = nil,

	--- 사출 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 투사체 shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- 투사체 helper
	shoot_helper = nil,

	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,

	calculator = nil,

	--- 액션 유형 목록
	action_type = nil,
	--- 현재 액션 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 평타 시전시 부여할 버프
	manual_buff_info = nil,

	--- 무기옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 무기옵션 일반공격 데미지 증가
	cwp_dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 무기옵션 일반공격 적중시 디버프 정보

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
