--region bonus state
local bonus_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
bonus_state_class.mt = { __index = bonus_state_class }

--- create break state
function bonus_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end


function bonus_state_class:init(param)
	self.fire_offset_vec = vector(0, 0, 0.2)

	self.offset_table = {}
	self.offset_table[direction_util.left] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, 0), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, 0) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.right] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, 0), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, 0) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.up] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.4), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.2) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.down] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.4), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.2) }

	--- 옵션에 모든 파라미터가 있어 옵션에서 처리
	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 장착중인 무기
	local weapon = character_util.get_weapon(self.owner)
	--- 전용 애니메이션 출력 여부
	local use_exclusive_anim = not character_util.is_using_equip_costume(self.owner, weapon)
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner) and use_exclusive_anim
end

function bonus_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)
		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
			--- parsing each info
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

			--- 롤액션 버프 정보
			self.role_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleBuff')

			--region basic info
			--- 액션 길이
			self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ActionDuration')

			--- 데미지 타입
			self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')
			--- 보너스 탄 배율
			self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ModifierBase')
			--- 보너스탄 폭발 배율
			self.explosion_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ExplosionModifier')

			--- 탐색 범위
			self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SearchRange')

			--- 적중 가능한 거리
			self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
			--endregion

			self.knockback_force = knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackScale')

			--region projectile info

			--- 투사체 정보 파싱 및 헬퍼
			self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)

			local shoot_helpers, proj_specs = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, option_param)
			self.shoot_helper = shoot_helpers[1]
			self.proj_spec = proj_specs[1]

			--- 개화 옵션에서 투사체를 덮어씌우는 부분이 있다.
			self:apply_myth_option(option_param)

			--- 투사체 최대 거리 (일단은 기본 탄의 거리)
			self.proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec)

			--- 발사 타이밍
			self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShootTiming')
			self.reload_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ReloadTiming')
			--- 발사 위치
			self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShootOffset')

			local radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec)

			--- 판정 정보, 판정의 시작은 지면부터.
			self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
			--- 판정 계산기
			self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)
			--endregion

			--- 대시 속도
			self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
			--- 대시 지속시간
			self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
			--- 롤액션 버프 정보
			self.role_hit_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleHitBuff')

			self:apply_myth_cwp_option(option_param)
		end

	until true end
end


function bonus_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 보너스 탄 배율
	self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 보너스탄 폭발 배율
	self.explosion_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ExplosionModifier')

	local shoot_helpers, proj_specs = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, myth_option_param)
	self.shoot_helper = shoot_helpers[1]
	self.proj_spec = proj_specs[1]

	self.action.preset_info = battle_util.try_parse_preset_info(self.owner, myth_option_param, self.action.preset_info)
	self.action.sfx_info = battle_util.try_parse_sfx_info(self.owner, myth_option_param, self.action.sfx_info)
end

function bonus_state_class:apply_myth_cwp_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	self.activate_cwp_myth_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)
end

function bonus_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function bonus_state_class:is_controlling()

--- action state enter
function bonus_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local anim_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast_ex' or 'cast_fallback'
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

	--- 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local cast_fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		-- 바라보는 방향에 맞는 오프셋 테이블을 가져오기 위함이니 look direction으로 대신 처리한다.
		local dir_type = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)
		local rotate_fire_offset = rot * self.offset_table[dir_type].fire_offset
		cast_fx_pos = cast_fx_pos + rotate_fire_offset
	end

	--- 시전자 위치에서의 시전 fx 생성
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast_ex',
		cast_fx_pos,
		self.dir_vector
	)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast_ex')
end

--- action state exit
function bonus_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	--- 연출 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function bonus_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 발사 전까지, 대상, 방향 갱신
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		local aim_pos = center

		if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
			-- 바라보는 방향에 맞는 오프셋 테이블을 가져오기 위함이니 look direction으로 대신 처리한다.
			local dir_type = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)
			local fire_offset = vector_util.normalized(self.dir_vector + rot * self.offset_table[dir_type].fire_offset)
			aim_pos = aim_pos + fire_offset
		else
			aim_pos = aim_pos + self.dir_vector
		end

		--- IK 갱신
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, aim_pos, center)
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, aim_pos)
	end

	--- 발사 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		self:shoot_projectile()
	end
	--- 액션 만료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
		else
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사 처리
function bonus_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- 버프 제거
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_buff_info.name)

	local anim_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'shoot_ex' or 'shoot_fallback'
	--- 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

	local center_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	local fire_pos = center_pos
	local shoot_pos = center_pos
	-- 바라보는 방향에 맞는 오프셋 테이블을 가져오기 위함이니 look direction으로 대신 처리한다.
	local dir_type = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)

		local shoot_offset = rot * self.offset_table[dir_type].shoot_offset
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos + vector_util.normalized(self.dir_vector + shoot_offset) * 0.9

		local fire_offset = rot * self.offset_table[dir_type].fire_offset
		fire_pos = fire_pos + vector_util.normalized(self.dir_vector + fire_offset) * 1.5
	else
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos + self.dir_vector
		fire_pos = fire_pos + self.dir_vector
	end

	--- 대상 위치, 없으면 최대사거리 목적지
	local target_pos = self.target and
		bounds_util.get_center(self.target) or
		shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.proj_max_dist

	--- 투사체 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper,
		shoot_pos,
		self.dir_vector,
		self.proj_type, -- label
		nil,
		nil,
		true,
		nil,
		nil
	)

	--- 발사 연출(fx)
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
		self.proj_spec,
		fire_pos,
		self.dir_vector,
		character_util.get_transform(self.owner),
		parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot_ex')

	--- 개화 무옵이 있을때만 여기서. 개화 무옵이 없으면 타격 시에 추가해준다.
	if self.activate_cwp_option and self.activate_cwp_myth_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_hit_buff_info)
	end

	if dir_type == direction_util.left or dir_type == direction_util.right then
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.7, 0.1, 0.4, 20)
	else
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0.5, 0.4, 0)
	end

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.18, 0.12)

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, nil, -self.dir_vector, 0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
		CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0, true
	)
end

--- 히트 시
function bonus_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 라이프 사이클 만료로 자연 소멸
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		return true
	end

	--- 뭔가에 적중 시
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			self:on_explosion(hit_info.position, label, hit_info.target, hit_info.direction)
			return false
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 폭발 범위 처리
function bonus_state_class:on_explosion(position, label, main_target, dir)
	--- 범위 내의 대상들
	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, position)
	if #hit_targets <= 0 then return end

	local main_modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_modifier)
	local explosion_modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.explosion_modifier)

	for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 직격과 폭발 피해 여부 구분
			local is_direct_hit = lua_helper.reference_equals(main_target, target)
			local modifier = is_direct_hit and main_modifier or explosion_modifier

			self:apply_damage(target, is_direct_hit, modifier, dir)
		end
	end

	--- 개화 무옵이 없을때만 여기서. 개화 무옵이 있으면 사용 시에 추가해준다.
	if self.activate_cwp_option and not self.activate_cwp_myth_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_hit_buff_info)
	end

	--- 연출
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec, position, dir)
end

--- 데미지 처리
function bonus_state_class:apply_damage(target, is_direct_hit, modifier, hit_dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.cwp_option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	--- 스턴은 기본 사양
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 직격만 넉백
	if is_direct_hit then
		damage_info.direction = hit_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = hit_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knockback_force
	end

	--- 히트음
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit_ex')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end
--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, param, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, param
	)

	--- 무기 투사체 구분 목적의 테이블
	self.proj_type = {
		normal_proj = 1,
		bonus_proj = 2
	}

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, param)
	self.bonus_state = bonus_state_class:new(self, param)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.bonus_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)
		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
			--- 롤액션 버프 정보
			local role_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleBuff')
			--- 체크할 롤액션 버프 아이디
			self.role_buff_id = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(role_buff_info.name).Id
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
		end

	until true end
end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.bonus_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.bonus_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded() and self.bonus_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 일반 공격중엔 무빙이 가능하고 브레이크때는 이동 불가
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

function local_class:allow_stamina_recovery()
	return not self.state_machine or self.state_machine:is_nil_state() or self.state_machine.state:allow_stamina_recovery()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			if self.activate_special_option and character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(self.owner, self.role_buff_id) then

				self:on_action_available(true)

			elseif battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
				self:on_action_available(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available(is_bonus)
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 추가타 공격 여부
	if self.activate_special_option and is_bonus then
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, 2)
	end

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		self.bonus_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.bonus_state)
	else
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.proj_type then return true end

	if label == self.proj_type.normal_proj then
		if not self.action_state then return true end

		return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	else
		if not self.bonus_state then return true end

		return self.bonus_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	end

	return false
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 해변의 과학자 소히(surfer_sohee) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualSurferSoheeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 판정 텀
	damage_term = nil,
	--- 판정이 끝나는 타이밍
	crash_end_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 최대 공격 가능 횟수
	max_hits = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 콤보 인덱스
	combo_index = nil,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 이미 영향을 준 대상
	hit_target = {},
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(
	parent_class, atk_modifier, damage_term, crash_end_timing, radius, dash_timing, dash_speed, dash_duration
)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.atk_modifier = atk_modifier
	obj.damage_term = damage_term
	obj.crash_end_timing = crash_end_timing
	obj.radius = radius
	obj.max_hits = math.floor((crash_end_timing - dash_timing) / damage_term) + 1
	obj.dash_timing = dash_timing
	obj.dash_speed = dash_speed
	obj.dash_duration = dash_duration

	if parent_class.preset_info['trail'] then
		obj.combo_index = 1
		--- 통과 가능한 충돌체 세팅
		obj.pass_crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.PassChargeCrashBehaviour(false, false, false)
	elseif parent_class.preset_info['spin'] then
		obj.combo_index = 2
	elseif parent_class.preset_info['flip'] then
		obj.combo_index = 3
	end

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.target = target
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
	)

	if self.combo_index == 1 or self.combo_index == 3 then
		min_dist = min_dist + 0.5
	end

	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= min_dist + self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'base')

	--- 1타인 경우에만 크래시 비헤비어를 바꿔줌
	if self.combo_index == 1 then
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.pass_crash_behaviour
	end
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 1타인 경우에만 크래시 비헤비어를 되돌려줌
	if self.combo_index == 1 then
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.pass_crash_behaviour)
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil
	--- 3타인 경우 회전 돌려줌
	elseif self.combo_index == 3 then
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)
	end

	--- 사용한 정보 비워줌
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_target) do
		self.hit_target[each_target] = nil
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 타겟 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.1, 0.1)
		end

		--- 대시 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'dash', self.owner.Position,
			self.dir_vector, self.owner.Transform, parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, false, 0
		)

		--- 타겟 비워줌
		self.target = nil

		if self.combo_index == 1 then
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing)

			--- 대시 트레일 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'dashtrail', self.owner.Position + 0.5 * self.dir_vector,
				self.dir_vector, self.owner.Transform, parent_follow_flag.position
			)

			--- 대시 트레일 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dashtrail')

		elseif self.combo_index == 2 then
			character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing, 0.1, false)

			--- 회전 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'spin', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
				nil, self.owner.Transform, parent_follow_flag.position
			)

			--- 회전 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'spin')

		elseif self.combo_index == 3 then
			--- 이펙트 오프셋
			local offset = 0.7

			if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				--- 백플립 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'flip', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + offset * unity_class.vector3.right,
					nil, self.owner.Transform, parent_follow_flag.position
				)
				spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(360, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing)
			else
				--- 백플립 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'flip2', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + offset * unity_class.vector3.left,
					nil, self.owner.Transform, parent_follow_flag.position
				)
				spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(-360, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing)
			end

			--- 플립 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'flip')

			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing)
			character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing, 0, true)
		end
	end

	--- 판정
	if self.dash_timing <= time_passed and old_time_passed < self.crash_end_timing then
		--- 2타 인 경우 적절하게 캐릭터를 돌려줌
		if self.combo_index == 2 then
			--- 두 사이클을 돈다
			local cycle = 2
			--- 어느 빈도로 돌려줄 것인가
			local rate = (self.crash_end_timing - self.dash_timing) / 4 / cycle
			local loop1 = math.floor((old_time_passed - self.dash_timing) / rate)
			local loop2 = math.floor((time_passed - self.dash_timing) / rate)

			--- 루프가 다를때 (회전해야할 타이밍)
			if loop1 < loop2 then
				--- 현재 바라보는 방향
				local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

				----- set locked dir
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction_util.get_cw_turn(look_dir, 1))
			end

			--- 판정이 끝난 타이밍
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.crash_end_timing) then
				--- 원래 방향으로 되돌려줌
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
			end
		--- 3타 인 경우
		elseif self.combo_index == 3 then
			--- 살짝 먼저 카메라를 흔들어줌
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.crash_end_timing - 0.1) and
				battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
				stage_camera:Shake(0.1, 0.1)
			end
		end

		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hits)
		local pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- 1, 3타의 경우 압쪽으로 판정을 조금 당겨줌
		if self.combo_index == 1 or self.combo_index == 3 then
			pos = pos + 0.5 * self.dir_vector
		end

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
			pos, self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				if self.hit_target[target] == nil or self.hit_target[target] + self.damage_term < time_passed then
					self.hit_target[target] = time_passed

					--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
					self.action:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.combo_index == 1 or self.combo_index == 3, true)
				end
			end

		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

--endregion

--region chain state

local chain_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 최대 타겟
	max_targets = nil,
	--- 최대 확산 거리
	distance = nil,
	--- 체크용 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,
	--- 쿨타임
	cool_time = nil,
	--- 피해량 감소 비율
	dmg_reduce_scale = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	already_trigger = false,
	left_time = 0,
}
chain_state_class.mt = { __index = chain_state_class }

function chain_state_class:new(parent_class, dm, mt, d, bi, ct, rs)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.dps_multiplier = dm
	obj.max_targets = mt
	obj.distance = d
	obj.buff_info = bi
	obj.cool_time = ct
	obj.dmg_reduce_scale = rs
	return obj
end

function chain_state_class:trigger(target)
	if self.already_trigger or self.left_time > 0 or battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) == false then return end

	self.already_trigger = true

	local chain_targets = {}
	chain_targets[target] = true

	--- sync 정보 생성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(target))

	for _ = 1, self.max_targets - 1 do
		chain_targets[target] = true

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
			bounds_util.get_center(target), self.distance, self.distance
		)

		for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) and chain_targets[each_target] == nil then
				target = each_target

				trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
				trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(target))
				break
			end
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		if chain_targets[target] then
			break
		end
	end

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
end

function chain_state_class:reset_cool_time()
	self.left_time = self.cool_time
	self.current_time_passed = 0
end

function chain_state_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent) then
		if e.Buff.BuffSpec.Name == self.buff_info.name then
			self:reset_cool_time()
		end
	end
end

function chain_state_class:sync(info)
	--- reset
	self:reset_cool_time()

	local first_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local start_pos = first_target and bounds_util.get_center(first_target) or trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'shoot', start_pos)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	--- 첫 타겟 판정
	if first_target then
		--- modifier 계산
		---
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier)

		--- 데미지 적
		self.action:apply_damage(first_target, modifier, false, false)
	end

	----- 타겟 루프
	for index = 2, info.Positions.Count do
		local current_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, index - 1)
		local end_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, index - 1)

		--- 현재 타겟이 존재할때
		if current_target then
			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier - self.dmg_reduce_scale * (index - 1)
			)

			end_pos = bounds_util.get_center(current_target)
			self.action:apply_damage(current_target, modifier, false, false)
		end

		local chain_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'chain', end_pos)

		local scaling_component = chain_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScalingEffect))

		if scaling_component then
			local diff = start_pos - end_pos
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.normalized(diff))
			local scale = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

			scaling_component:SetTransform(end_pos, rot, scale)
		end

		start_pos = end_pos
	end
end

--- Chain 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
function chain_state_class:update(_, _, dt)
	if self.left_time > 0 then
		self.left_time = self.left_time - dt

		if self.left_time <= 0 then
			self.already_trigger = false
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	local attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase')
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대상틀 탐색할 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 판정 텀
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 판정이 끝날 타이밍
	local crash_end_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CrashEndTiming')
	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 대시 타이밍 (판정 시작 타이밍)
	local dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	local dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 길이
	local dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')

	--- 기본 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(
		self, attack_modifier, damage_term, crash_end_timing, radius, dash_timing, dash_speed, dash_duration
	)
	--- 기본 액션 스테이트 머신
	self.current_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 바닥에 깔릴 트레일 이펙트
	self.trail_fx = nil
	--- 지난 프레임의 트레일 포지션
	self.trail_pos = nil

	--- 전용 옵션 관련 파싱
	self:apply_option(cs_action, params)
end

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되어있을때
	if activate_option then
		--- parsing each info
		_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, option_param, nil, nil, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		--- 적에게 입힐 데미지 계수
		local dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')
		--- 최대 영향을 줄 타겟
		local max_targets = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MaxTargets')
		--- 최대 확산 거리
		local distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'Distance')
		--- 쿨타임 체크용 버프
		local buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)

		--- 버프 데이터
		local buff_param = game_data_service.GetData('BuffData'):GetBuffSpecFromName(buff_info.name).Data

		--- 쿨타임
		local cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Duration')

		--- 피해량 감소 비율
		local dmg_reduce_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ReduceScale')

		self.chain_state = chain_state_class:new(
			self, dps_multiplier, max_targets, distance, buff_info, cool_time, dmg_reduce_scale
		)
		self.chain_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.chain_state, self)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil

		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(self.owner)
	end

	--region state 해지
	do
		if self.chain_state_machine then
			self.chain_state_machine:change(nil)
			self.chain_state_machine = nil
		end

		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.current_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.chain_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.chain_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state_machine and self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.current_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.chain_state then self.chain_state:sync(info) end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 트레일 상태를 갱신한다.
	self:update_trail()

	if self.current_state_machine then self.current_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.chain_state_machine then self.chain_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:update_trail()
	-- 캐릭터가 활성화되지 않은 상태라면 굳이 트레일을 갱신하지 않는다.
	if self.owner.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
		-- 만약 트레일이 붙어있었다면 해제한다.
		if self.trail_fx then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
			self.trail_fx = nil
		end

		return
	end

	-- 트레일 이펙트가 존재하는 경우
	if self.trail_fx then
		--- 이펙트 갱신을 위한 캐릭터 현재 위치
		local current_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 한 프레임에 움직인 diff가 너무 크면 새로 생성 (이펙트가 기믹등에서 튀는 것을 막기 위함)
		if vector_util.sqr_distance(current_pos, self.trail_pos) > 25 then
			--- 이펙트 해지
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)

			--- 트레일 이펙트 생성
			--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
			self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'trail', self.owner, current_pos)
		else
			--- 단순히 이펙트 위치 갱신
			effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, current_pos, nil)
		end

		--- 프레일 포지션 갱신
		self.trail_pos = current_pos

		return
	end

	if stage.StageStarted and stage.SmokeManager and
		self.preset_info['trail'] and object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(self.preset_info['trail']) then
		--- 스모크 때줌
		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(self.owner)

		--- 이펙트 갱신을 위한 캐릭터 현재 위치
		local current_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		--- 트레일 이펙트 생성
		--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
		self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'trail', self.owner, current_pos)
		--- 프레일 포지션 갱신
		self.trail_pos = current_pos
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_knock_back, apply_option)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)

	--- 일반 평타, 옵션 데미지가 아니라, 아래 chainState를 적용하겠단 의미.
	if apply_option then
		damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

		if apply_knock_back then
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
			damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force
		end

		--- 히트 이펙트 적용
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)

		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

		if self.chain_state then
			self.chain_state:trigger(target)
		end

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	else
		--- 체인 라이트닝. 옵션에 의해 트리거된 데미지임으로 데미지는 패시브 처리
		--- 패시브 플래그 추가
		damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
		--- FIXME: 소스타입은 무기옵션에 의한 부분이 맞지만, 현재 modifier 넘어온건, 일피증을 받을 수 있다. (chain_state 참고)
		--- 이미 출시된 상태라 너프가 불가?
		damage_info.source_type = damage_info.source_type | damage_source_type.cwp_option

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.1)
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.chain_state then
		self.chain_state:on_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 크레이그 5타 일반기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualTankerAscentBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 판정 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 판정 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌 계산기
	calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 공격판정 유지 시간
	--- (action_duration - hit_timing) * 0.67 으로 계산 하도록 되어있음. hit_timing 이후 공격 판정 계산 시작 하므로..
	self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 실제 공격 판정시간
	self.attack_duration = math.min(self.attack_duration, self.action.action_duration)

	--- 판정 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 판정 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- 충돌체 사이즈
	local size = vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width)
	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			size, self.attack_duration, nil, true)

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, 1)

end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 제자리에 서서 타격 검사 함. 전체 관통이므로 거리 검사만 하면 됨.
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return dist <= self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	-- 애니메이션 세트
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'bash')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기가 존재할 경우
	if self.calculator then
		--- 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 있을 경우
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 실드배시 루틴
	self:shield_bash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 계산 루틴
	self:calculator_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

end

function action_state_class:shield_bash_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 타격 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- set calculator position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- set calculator direction
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- start calculator
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 방패 에서 나가는 빛 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'light', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
		--- play action sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'bash')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)
	end
end

function action_state_class:calculator_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 계산기가 시작되었을때
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- update position
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target)
		until true end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_table.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_table.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = target
	damage_table.modifier = modifier
	damage_table.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_table.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 방패만 착용한 상태의 처리
	if character_util.get_dps(self.owner) == 0 then
		--- 방어력 무시
		damage_table.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		--- 데미지 1
		damage_table.damage = 1
	end

	--- 힛 이펙트가 존재할 경우
	if self.action.preset_info['hit'] then
		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		damage_table.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	end

	if self.action.preset_info['optionhit'] then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'optionhit', bounds_util.get_center(target))
	end

	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_table.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제

	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부

end

--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부

	return true
end

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 쌍둥이 안드로이드 니프티 (twins_android) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualTwinsAndroidBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper_table = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec_table = nil,

	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 일반 투사체 projectile spec
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 투사체의 최대 사거리
	local proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec_table[1])
	--- 투사체 최대 사거리로부터얻은 hittable_range
	self.hittable_dist = proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	--전무 개화 분기
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터 - myth_param이 아닌, 그냥 param에서 들고있음
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param, nil, nil, 'MythProjectileInfo')
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper_table == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper_table)
end

--- 액션 중 움직일 수 있는지?
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상과 공격 거리 비교
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니메이션은 upper로 세팅. 캐스팅 중 이동하면 걸어야함
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- IK 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		self:shoot_projectile()
	end

	--- 액션 만료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		else--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- [OnHit] 적중 시 피해
function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우 데미지 계산
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
		)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier)

		--- 피격 이펙트와 카메라 쉐이킹 약하게
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], bounds_util.get_center(hit_info.target))
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.1)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 평타 적중에 대한 데미지 커맨드 처리
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.action.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.action.cwp_debuff_info)
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사 로직
function action_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 시전자 위치 + 바라보는 방향 * 발사 오프셋 (총구쯤에서 쏘게끔)
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec_table[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper_table[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector,1)
end

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사
function break_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 시전자 위치 + 바라보는 방향 * 발사 오프셋 (총구쯤에서 쏘게끔)
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--print('break offset..'..tostring(self.shoot_offset))

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec_table[2], shoot_pos + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector, nil, false)

	-- 레이져 fx 처리
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'laser', shoot_pos + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector,
		nil
	)

	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
		self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
	)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.2)

	--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
	if #hit_targets > 0 then
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier * self.break_modifier)
			--- 투사체 적중 fx
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[2], bounds_util.get_center(target))
		end
	end
end

--- 브레이크 탄 적중에 대한 데미지 처리
function break_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.action.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.action.cwp_debuff_info)
	end

end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 일반 공격 클래스
	self.normal_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 브레이크 어택 클래스
	self.break_state = break_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.normal_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.break_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:apply_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
			else
				self.activate_cwp_option = true
				self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
				-- 개화 버프 가져오기용 파싱
				local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)
				if myth_activate_option then
					self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_option_param, 'Debuff')
				end
			end

		until true
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.normal_state, self.break_state)

		self.normal_state = nil
		self.break_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부 & 스테이트 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.normal_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.normal_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색 (투사체용 타겟 서칭)
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 브레이크 공격 타이밍이라면 스테미나 브레이크
	if discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	end

	--- 커맨드 전파
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.break_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.break_state)
	else
		self.normal_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.normal_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == 1 then
		--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
		if self.normal_state == nil then return true end
		--- 평타 투사체 처리
		return self.normal_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 쌍둥이 안드로이드 니프티 소환수(twins_android_turret) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualTwinsAndroidTurretBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')

	self.shoot_offset_y = vector(0,0.5,0)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(_)
	--- 이동 불가 캐릭터, 가까운적 판정을 위해 hittable을 항상 true로
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 세팅
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if self.target  then
		--- 대상, 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector + self.shoot_offset_y
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then

		--- 액션 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 발사 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)

		--- 투사체 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

		--- 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion
